guide.summary: 就 and 才 are adverbs that add the speaker's attitude. 就 says something happened sooner, faster or more easily than expected; 才 says it happened later, slower or with more effort. Both sit after the subject and before the verb. The time or amount they comment on comes before them (八点就来了 / 八点才来). When a number comes after 才, it means 'only' (才三岁).

subs.label: 就 sooner / 才 later than expected
subs.focus: Choose 就 or 才 from the speaker's attitude to a time, amount or effort stated BEFORE the adverb. A clue must force one reading (contrast clause like 电影七点开始, a small/large amount, or final 了 present/absent). Mistake: translating 'then' and ignoring early/easy (就) vs late/hard (才).

subs.label: 了 with 就, no 了 with 才
subs.focus: Decide whether 了 belongs: one finished event with 就 takes 了 (八点就来了); standard 才 'not until' takes none (八点才来). 才…了 is heard in speech: never the only wrong option or a judge-wrong sentence. Single past events only; no habitual or future 就, no 才 'only' + amount (才学了两个月 is correct).

subs.label: 才 + number = only
subs.focus: 才 BEFORE a number, age, price or clock time = 'only, that's few' (才三岁, 现在才七点), versus the number before 才/就 (三岁才会说话). Mistake: number on the wrong side of 才, or 都/已经 for 'only'. Never make 就 or 只 a distractor right before a number (就三个人 is fine).

subs.label: 就 = only (就他一个人)
subs.focus: 就 = 'only' before a person or noun (就他一个人没来, 我们班就小王会开车) or before a verb with a small amount (我就有十块钱). Mistake: leaving 就 after the person it limits, or reading it as 'then'. Distractors 都, 也, 还, 再; never 才 or 只, which can also be right.

subs.label: 就 = precisely / right now (就是, 就在, 马上就)
subs.focus: Emphatic 就 right before 是/在 = 'precisely, right here' (我就是, 这儿就是我家, 就在那儿), or after 现在/马上 = 'right away' (马上就来). Mistake: 就 after 是/在 (在就那儿), or picking 都/也. Context must show identification or immediacy. Do not use 才 as a distractor before 是.

subs.label: 一…就 as soon as
subs.focus: Build 一 + action 1 + 就 + action 2, each word after its own subject and right before its verb. Mistakes: 就 before the second subject (老师一说，就我明白了), 才 or 也 instead of 就, 一 before a pronoun subject. Cover 'as soon as' (one event) and 'whenever' (habit: 他一喝酒就脸红).

subs.label: 只要…就 / 只有…才 / 如果…就
subs.focus: Pair the adverb with the conjunction: 只要 (as long as) and 如果/要是 (if) take 就; 只有 (only if) takes 才. Mistakes: 只有…就, 只要…才, or no adverb at all because English has none. Show one half of the pair and make the learner choose the other; two-blank cloze 只要|就 also works.

subs.label: Where 就 / 才 go
subs.focus: Put 就/才 after the subject and the time word, right before the verb, modal or coverb phrase (他昨天十一点才回家, 你不去我就不去). Best as order and judge items. Mistake: English 'then I' order with 就/才 before the subject (如果你去，就我去). Include a second-clause subject so placement must be decided.

rules.rule: Time or amount first, then 就 if it feels early, fast or easy; 才 if it feels late, slow or hard. English often says 'as early as / already' for 就 and 'not until / only then' for 才.
rules.pattern: Subject + time / amount + 就 / 才 + Verb

examples.py: tā bā diǎn jiù lái le
examples.en: He came at eight (that was early).

examples.py: tā bā diǎn cái lái
examples.en: He didn't come until eight (that was late).

examples.zh: 电影七点开始，他六点半就到了。
examples.py: diàn yǐng qī diǎn kāi shǐ tā liù diǎn bàn jiù dào le
examples.en: The film started at seven, and he was already there at half past six.

examples.zh: 我等了一个小时，他才来。
examples.py: wǒ děng le yī gè xiǎo shí tā cái lái
examples.en: I waited an hour before he finally came.

rules.rule: The same contrast works for effort and amounts, not just clock times: little effort before 就, a lot of effort before 才.
rules.pattern: small effort + 就 + result / big effort + 才 + result

examples.py: wǒ kàn yī biàn jiù dǒng le
examples.en: I understood after reading it just once.

examples.py: wǒ kàn le sān biàn cái dǒng
examples.en: I had to read it three times before I understood.

examples.py: zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le
examples.en: It's just a five-minute walk.

examples.zh: 她找了半天才找到手机。
examples.py: tā zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào shǒu jī
examples.en: She looked for ages before she found her phone.

rules.rule: For one finished event, 就 goes with 了; the standard form with 才 has no 了. If you want to add 了 after 'not until' 才, leave it out.
rules.pattern: time + 就 + Verb + 了 / time + 才 + Verb

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上九点就睡了。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang jiǔ diǎn jiù shuì le
examples.en: I went to bed as early as nine last night.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上十二点才睡。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái shuì
examples.en: I didn't go to bed until twelve last night.

examples.py: tā èr shí suì jiù jié hūn le
examples.en: She got married at just twenty.

examples.py: tā sì shí suì cái jié hūn
examples.en: He didn't get married until he was forty.

rules.note: 了 comes with 就 only because the event is finished: habits and plans have none (他每天六点就起床). 才 'only' + amount can take verb 了: 我才学了两个月. Natives do sometimes say 才…了 (他十点才来了) in casual speech; exams expect it without 了.

rules.rule: 才 directly before a number, age, price or clock time means 'only', with the feeling that it is few, young, cheap or early.

examples.py: tā cái sān suì
examples.en: She's only three.

examples.py: zhè běn shū cái wǔ kuài qián
examples.en: This book is only five kuai.

examples.py: xiàn zài cái qī diǎn bù yòng zháo jí
examples.en: It's only seven o'clock, no need to rush.

examples.py: wǒ cái xué le liǎng ge yuè zhōng wén
examples.en: I've only been learning Chinese for two months.

rules.rule: Look at which side of 才 the number is on. Number after 才 = 'only that much'. Number before 才 = 'not until then'.
rules.pattern: 才 + number (only) / number + 才 + Verb (not until)

examples.py: tā cái wǔ suì
examples.en: He's only five.

examples.py: tā wǔ suì cái huì shuō huà
examples.en: He didn't talk until he was five.

examples.py: tā wǔ suì jiù huì yóu yǒng le
examples.en: She could already swim at five.

rules.rule: 就 can mean 'only / just'. It goes right before the person or thing it limits, even in front of the subject, or before a verb followed by a small amount.
rules.pattern: 就 + person / noun + ... or Subject + 就 + Verb + small amount

examples.py: jiù tā yī gè rén méi lái
examples.en: He's the only one who didn't come.

examples.py: wǒ men bān jiù xiǎo wáng huì kāi chē
examples.en: In our class only Xiao Wang can drive.

examples.py: wǒ jiù yǒu shí kuài qián
examples.en: I only have ten kuai.

examples.py: wǒ jiù qù guo yī cì běi jīng
examples.en: I've only been to Beijing once.

rules.note: Before a number, 就, 才 and 只 can all mean 'only' (就三个人 / 才三个人 / 只有三个人); 才 adds the feeling 'that's so few'. To single out a person, use 就 or 只有.

rules.rule: 就 before 是 or 在 points and says 'precisely this one, right here'. After 现在 or 马上 it says 'right away'. It goes before 是 / 在 / the verb, never after.
rules.pattern: Subject + 就 + 是 / 在 + ... ; 马上 / 现在 + 就 + Verb

examples.py: wǒ jiù shì lǐ lǎo shī
examples.en: I am Teacher Li (the very person you're looking for).

examples.py: zhè r jiù shì wǒ jiā
examples.en: This right here is my home.

examples.py: xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài nà r
examples.en: The toilet is right over there.

examples.py: nǐ děng yī xià wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái
examples.en: Hold on, I'll be right there.

rules.rule: 'As soon as A, B' or 'whenever A, B' is 一 A 就 B. 一 and 就 each stand right before their own verb, after any subject.
rules.pattern: Subject + 一 + Verb 1 + (Subject 2) + 就 + Verb 2

examples.zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。
examples.py: wǒ yī dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I get home.

examples.py: tā yī hē jiǔ jiù liǎn hóng
examples.en: His face goes red whenever he drinks.

examples.py: lǎo shī yī shuō wǒ jiù míng bai le
examples.en: As soon as the teacher explained, I understood.

rules.rule: 只要 (as long as) and 如果 / 要是 (if) are answered by 就: the condition is enough, the result follows easily.
rules.pattern: 只要 / 如果 + condition + (Subject) + 就 + result

examples.py: zhǐ yào nǐ nǔ lì jiù néng xué hǎo
examples.en: As long as you work hard, you can learn it well.

examples.zh: 只要有时间，我就去看你。
examples.py: zhǐ yào yǒu shí jiān wǒ jiù qù kàn nǐ
examples.en: As long as I have time, I'll come and see you.

examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
examples.py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù le
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

rules.note: In casual speech 就 is sometimes dropped after 如果, but in these drills always put it in.

rules.rule: 只有 (only if) is answered by 才: this is the one condition that must be met, so the result is hard to get. 才 is very often followed by 能 or 会.
rules.pattern: 只有 + condition + (Subject) + 才 + 能 / 会 + result

examples.zh: 只有多练习，才能说得好。
examples.py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí cái néng shuō de hǎo
examples.en: Only by practising a lot can you speak well.

examples.py: zhǐ yǒu tā qù wǒ cái qù
examples.en: I'll go only if he goes.

examples.zh: 只有周末，我才有时间看电影。
examples.py: zhǐ yǒu zhōu mò wǒ cái yǒu shí jiān kàn diàn yǐng
examples.en: Only at weekends do I have time to watch films.

rules.rule: 就 and 才 are adverbs: after the subject, after the time word, right before the verb, modal verb or 在 / 给 / 跟 phrase. They never start a clause the way English 'then' does.
rules.pattern: Subject + time + 就 / 才 + (modal / coverb phrase) + Verb

examples.py: wǒ men míng tiān jiù zǒu
examples.en: We're leaving as soon as tomorrow.

examples.zh: 他昨天晚上十一点才回家。
examples.py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shang shí yī diǎn cái huí jiā
examples.en: He didn't get home until eleven last night.

examples.py: nǐ bù qù wǒ jiù bù qù
examples.en: If you don't go, then I won't go.

examples.zh: 作业写完了，你才能看电视。
examples.py: zuò yè xiě wán le nǐ cái néng kàn diàn shì
examples.en: You can watch television only after your homework is done.

rules.note: 就 in front of a subject is a different word in effect: it means 'only' (就我去 = only I am going).

right.py: tā zuó tiān shí diǎn cái lái
right.en: He didn't come until ten yesterday.

contrasts.why: In standard usage 才 'not until' takes no 了, even though the event is finished; 了 goes with 就. You will hear 才…了 in casual speech, but leave it out.

right.py: tā zuó tiān bā diǎn jiù lái le
right.en: He came as early as eight yesterday.

contrasts.why: A single finished event with 就 needs 了. Without it the sentence sounds like a plan or a habit, which clashes with 昨天.

right.py: rú guǒ nǐ qù wǒ jiù qù
right.en: If you go, then I'll go.

contrasts.why: English puts 'then' before 'I'; Chinese puts 就 after the subject, right before the verb. 就我去 would mean 'only I go'.

contrasts.wrong: 只有多练习，就能说得好。

right.zh: 只有多练习，才能说得好。
right.py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí cái néng shuō de hǎo
right.en: Only by practising a lot can you speak well.

contrasts.why: 只有 names the one necessary condition, so the result is hard-won: it pairs with 才. 就 pairs with 只要 and 如果.

right.py: zhǐ yào nǐ lái wǒ jiù gāo xìng
right.en: As long as you come, I'll be happy.

contrasts.why: 只要 says the condition is enough, so the result follows easily: its regular partner is 就. 才 belongs with 只有 in the first clause.

contrasts.wrong: 我一到家才给你打电话。

right.zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。
right.py: wǒ yī dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
right.en: I'll call you as soon as I get home.

contrasts.why: 一 A 就 B means B follows A immediately. 才 means 'late', the opposite idea, so it cannot complete 一.

right.py: xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài nà r
right.en: The toilet is right over there.

contrasts.why: 就 is an adverb and must come before 在 or 是, not between 在 and the place.

right.py: wǒ kàn le sān biàn cái dǒng
right.en: I had to read it three times before I understood.

contrasts.why: Three readings is a lot of effort, and there is no 了 at the end: both point to 才. With 就 it would have to be little effort plus 了: 我看一遍就懂了.

cheat: Early, fast, easy → 就. Late, slow, hard-won → 才.
Finished event: 就 … 了; 才 normally with no 了.
Number after 才 = only (才三岁). Number before 才 = not until (三岁才…).
只要 / 如果 / 一 → 就. 只有 → 才.
就 / 才 go after the subject and the time, right before the verb. Never 就我… for 'then I'.
就 in front of a person = only (就他一个人). 就是 / 就在 = precisely, right here.

items.q: 你先坐，经理现在___过来。
items.zh: 你先坐，经理现在就过来。
items.py: nǐ xiān zuò jīng lǐ xiàn zài jiù guò lái
items.en: Please sit down; the manager is coming over right now.
items.why: 现在 + 就 says 'immediately'. 又 'again', 也 'also' and 还 'still' make 现在 contradict the idea of coming right away.

items.q: 我昨天太累了，晚上八点___睡了。
items.zh: 我昨天太累了，晚上八点就睡了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān tài lèi le wǎn shàng bā diǎn jiù shuì le
items.en: I was so tired yesterday that I went to bed as early as eight in the evening.
items.why: Tiredness explains an early bedtime, so 就 and 了. 才 would imply that eight was late, which makes no sense for going to bed.

items.s: 我找了半天就找到手机。
items.s_py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān jiù zhǎo dào shǒu jī
items.zh: 我找了半天才找到手机。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào shǒu jī
items.en: I looked for ages before I found my phone.
items.why: 半天 shows long effort and there is no 了, so the adverb must be 才. 就 would suit an easy, quick find with 了.

items.q: 这个字很简单，我看一遍___会写了。
items.zh: 这个字很简单，我看一遍就会写了。
items.py: zhè ge zì hěn jiǎn dān wǒ kàn yī biàn jiù huì xiě le
items.en: This character is easy; I could write it after looking at it just once.
items.why: One look is little effort and the sentence ends in 了, so 就. 才 would suggest many tries, which contradicts 很简单.

items.q: 这本书___五块钱，很便宜。
items.zh: 这本书才五块钱，很便宜。
items.py: zhè běn shū cái wǔ kuài qián hěn pián yi
items.en: This book is only five kuai; it's cheap.
items.why: 才 before a price means 'only that little', matching 很便宜. 都 would say 'even', 也 'also' and 又 'again'.

items.q: 她二十二岁就大学毕业___。
items.zh: 她二十二岁就大学毕业了。
items.py: tā èr shí èr suì jiù dà xué bì yè le
items.en: She graduated from university at just twenty-two.
items.why: 就 with an early age needs 了 to close the finished event. 过 would turn it into 'has graduated at some time' and 着 does not go with 毕业.

items.q: 老师一说，我___明白了。
items.zh: 老师一说，我就明白了。
items.py: lǎo shī yī shuō wǒ jiù míng bái le
items.en: As soon as the teacher spoke, I understood.
items.why: In 一 A 就 B, 就 is the partner of 一. 才 means 'late', the opposite of 'as soon as', and 也 and 还 do not fit this frame.

items.q: 这里的老师都很热情，___你有问题，___可以随时问我。
items.zh: 这里的老师都很热情，只要你有问题，就可以随时问我。
items.py: zhè lǐ de lǎo shī dōu hěn rè qíng zhǐ yào nǐ yǒu wèn tí jiù kě yǐ suí shí wèn wǒ
items.en: The teachers here are all friendly; as long as you have a question, you can ask me any time.
items.why: 只要 ... 就 says one easy condition suffices, matching 随时 'any time'. 只有 ... 才 would make the question the sole condition, which clashes with 随时.

items.s: 小王一下班就去健身房。
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng yī xià bān jiù qù jiàn shēn fáng
items.zh: 小王一下班就去健身房。
items.py: xiǎo wáng yī xià bān jiù qù jiàn shēn fáng
items.en: Xiao Wang goes to the gym as soon as he gets off work.
items.why: Habit with 一…就 takes no 了. 就 stands right before 去 after the first clause, which is the normal pattern.

items.src_py: xǐ shǒu jiān zài nà r
items.task: Say it is right over there, with 就.
items.zh: 洗手间就在那儿。
items.py: xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài nà r
items.en: The toilet is right over there.
items.why: 就 goes before 在, not after it. 在就那儿 would be a word-order error.

items.q: 只有周末，我___有时间看电影。
items.zh: 只有周末，我才有时间看电影。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu zhōu mò wǒ cái yǒu shí jiān kàn diàn yǐng
items.en: Only at weekends do I have time to watch films.
items.why: 只有 + a restricted time is answered by 才: weekends are the only time. 就 would pair with 只要, and 又 and 也 do not mean 'only then'.

items.q: 只有多听多说，你___能学好中文。
items.zh: 只有多听多说，你才能学好中文。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duō tīng duō shuō nǐ cái néng xué hǎo zhōng wén
items.en: Only by listening and speaking a lot can you learn Chinese well.
items.why: 只有 names the one necessary condition and is answered by 才. 就 pairs with 只要 or 如果, so 就 here would mix up two patterns.

items.zh: 老师一讲我就懂了。
items.py: lǎo shī yī jiǎng wǒ jiù dǒng le
items.en: As soon as the teacher explained it, I understood.
items.why: 一 stands right before its verb 讲 and 就 right before 懂了, each after its own subject. 就 before 我 would turn it into 'only I'.

items.q: 现在___十点，会议要到十二点才结束，你不用着急走。
items.zh: 现在才十点，会议要到十二点才结束，你不用着急走。
items.py: xiàn zài cái shí diǎn huì yì yào dào shí èr diǎn cái jié shù nǐ bù yòng zháo jí zǒu
items.en: It's only ten now, and the meeting won't end until twelve, so there's no need to rush off.
items.why: 才 before 十点 means 'only ten, still early', which supports 不用着急. 都 would need 了 and would suggest it is late.

items.zh: 他七点才起床。
items.py: tā qī diǎn cái qǐ chuáng
items.en: He didn't get up until seven.
items.why: 才 follows the time 七点 and precedes 起床, with no 了. 才 cannot come at the end of the sentence.

items.zh: 你不去我就不去。
items.py: nǐ bù qù wǒ jiù bù qù
items.en: If you don't go, I won't go either.
items.why: The second clause is 我就不去, with 就 after the subject. 就 before 我 would mean 'only I don't go'.

items.q: 这个孩子五岁___会说话，家人都很着急。
items.zh: 这个孩子五岁才会说话，家人都很着急。
items.py: zhè ge hái zi wǔ suì cái huì shuō huà jiā rén dōu hěn zháo jí
items.en: This child didn't speak until he was five, and the family was very worried.
items.why: The number comes before the adverb, so it means 'not until five': 才 plus 会, with no 了. 就 would say he spoke early, but 家人都很着急 shows it was late.

items.src: 我到了公司，给你打电话。
items.src_py: wǒ dào le gōng sī gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.task: Rewrite with 一…就 to say 'as soon as'.
items.zh: 我一到公司就给你打电话。
items.py: wǒ yī dào gōng sī jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: I'll call you as soon as I get to the office.
items.why: 一 goes right before 到公司 and 就 right before the second action. 就 cannot come before 我 or after 给你打电话.

items.q: 公司___成立三个月，员工只有五个人，还需要慢慢发展。
items.zh: 公司才成立三个月，员工只有五个人，还需要慢慢发展。
items.py: gōng sī cái chéng lì sān gè yuè yuán gōng zhǐ yǒu wǔ gè rén hái xū yào màn màn fā zhǎn
items.en: The company was only founded three months ago and has just five staff; it needs to grow slowly.
items.why: 才 before 成立三个月 stresses how new it is. 又 'again', 也 'also' and 再 'once more' make no sense with a duration.

items.s: 要是你累了，我们才休息一会儿吧。
items.s_py: yào shì nǐ lèi le wǒ men cái xiū xī yī huì r ba
items.zh: 要是你累了，我们就休息一会儿吧。
items.py: yào shì nǐ lèi le wǒ men jiù xiū xī yī huì r ba
items.en: If you're tired, let's rest for a while.
items.why: 要是 'if' is answered by 就. 才 would require 只有 and does not go with a suggestion ending in 吧.

items.q: 你找李老师吗？我___是李老师。
items.zh: 你找李老师吗？我就是李老师。
items.py: nǐ zhǎo lǐ lǎo shī ma wǒ jiù shì lǐ lǎo shī
items.en: Are you looking for Teacher Li? I am Teacher Li.
items.why: 就 before 是 says 'precisely me, the one you're looking for'. 也 would say 'I too am Teacher Li', and 都 and 还 do not fit an identification.

items.s: 我们班才小王会开车。
items.s_py: wǒ men bān cái xiǎo wáng huì kāi chē
items.zh: 我们班就小王会开车。
items.py: wǒ men bān jiù xiǎo wáng huì kāi chē
items.en: In our class only Xiao Wang can drive.
items.why: To single out one person, use 就 (or 只有). 才 before a person does not mean 'only' and is not used this way.

items.q: 老师讲得很清楚，大家听一遍___明白了，没有人需要再问。
items.zh: 老师讲得很清楚，大家听一遍就明白了，没有人需要再问。
items.py: lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn qīng chǔ dà jiā tīng yī biàn jiù míng bái le méi yǒu rén xū yào zài wèn
items.en: The teacher explained it clearly, so everyone understood after hearing it once and nobody needed to ask again.
items.why: One hearing is little effort, nobody needs to ask again, and 了 closes the clause: 就. 才 would mean it took repeated effort, the opposite.

items.q: 我___有十块钱，不能请你吃饭。
items.zh: 我就有十块钱，不能请你吃饭。
items.py: wǒ jiù yǒu shí kuài qián bù néng qǐng nǐ chī fàn
items.en: I only have ten kuai, so I can't treat you to a meal.
items.why: 就 before 有 and a small sum means 'only ten kuai', which explains why 不能请你. 也 would mean 'I also have ten', and 都 and 再 don't fit.

items.q: 你把报告改好，___经理___会签字。
items.zh: 你把报告改好，经理才会签字。
items.py: nǐ bǎ bào gào gǎi hǎo jīng lǐ cái huì qiān zì
items.en: Only when you've corrected the report will the manager sign it.
items.why: 才 sits after the subject 经理 and before 会: 经理才会签字. 才 in front of the subject is not Chinese word order.

items.s: 我一到家才给你打电话。
items.s_py: wǒ yī dào jiā cái gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。
items.py: wǒ yī dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: I'll call you as soon as I get home.
items.why: 一 A 就 B means 'immediately', but 才 means 'late', the opposite. 一 can only be completed by 就.

items.q: 这份报告特别复杂，小李写了三天___写好。
items.zh: 这份报告特别复杂，小李写了三天才写好。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào tè bié fù zá xiǎo lǐ xiě le sān tiān cái xiě hǎo
items.en: The report is very complicated; it took Xiao Li three days to finish writing it.
items.why: Complicated and three days point to effort, and there is no 了 after 好: 才. 就 would need an easy task and a final 了.

items.q: 我___学了两个月中文，说得不太好。
items.zh: 我才学了两个月中文，说得不太好。
items.py: wǒ cái xué le liǎng gè yuè zhōng wén shuō de bù tài hǎo
items.en: I've only studied Chinese for two months, so I don't speak it very well.
items.why: 才 before a short span means 'only two months', which explains 说得不太好. 也 'also', 又 'again' and 再 'again later' do not express 'only'.

items.q: 我一看到这道题___头疼。
items.zh: 我一看到这道题就头疼。
items.py: wǒ yī kàn dào zhè dào tí jiù tóu téng
items.en: My head starts to hurt the moment I see this problem.
items.why: 一…就 expresses an immediate reaction, here headache right after seeing the problem. 才 would mean 'not until', and 也 and 还 do not fit.

items.q: 办公室里的同事都下班了，___我一个人还在加班。
items.zh: 办公室里的同事都下班了，就我一个人还在加班。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ de tóng shì dōu xià bān le jiù wǒ yí gè rén hái zài jiā bān
items.en: All my colleagues in the office have gone home; only I am still working overtime.
items.why: 就 in front of 我一个人 marks 'only me' after everyone else left. 也 would mean I'm also working, which clashes with 都下班了; 都 and 又 do not fit.

items.s: 我才学了三个月英语，还听不懂电影。
items.s_py: wǒ cái xué le sān gè yuè yīng yǔ hái tīng bù dǒng diàn yǐng
items.zh: 我才学了三个月英语，还听不懂电影。
items.py: wǒ cái xué le sān gè yuè yīng yǔ hái tīng bù dǒng diàn yǐng
items.en: I've only studied English for three months and still can't understand films.
items.why: 才 meaning 'only' before a short span may be followed by 了 after the verb, since 了 here marks the duration so far. The 'not until' rule does not apply.

items.zh: 就小李一个人没交作业。
items.py: jiù xiǎo lǐ yí gè rén méi jiāo zuò yè
items.en: Xiao Li is the only one who didn't hand in his homework.
items.why: 就 stands directly before the person it limits, at the head of the sentence. After 没 it would not single him out.

items.s: 只要你肯学，就一定能学会。
items.s_py: zhǐ yào nǐ kěn xué jiù yí dìng néng xué huì
items.zh: 只要你肯学，就一定能学会。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ kěn xué jiù yí dìng néng xué huì
items.en: As long as you're willing to study, you'll definitely be able to learn it.
items.why: 只要 is answered by 就, and 就 stands before 一定 and 能. The adverbs 一定 and 能 do not need 才.

items.q: 你不是在找我们的教室吗？这儿___是。
items.zh: 你不是在找我们的教室吗？这儿就是。
items.py: nǐ bú shì zài zhǎo wǒ men de jiào shì ma zhè r jiù shì
items.en: Aren't you looking for our classroom? This is it, right here.
items.why: 就 before 是 says 'precisely this place'. 也 would say 'this is also one', which does not answer the search, and 都 and 又 do not fit.

items.q: 他四十岁才结婚___，所以孩子还很小。
items.zh: 他四十岁才结婚，所以孩子还很小。
items.py: tā sì shí suì cái jié hūn suǒ yǐ hái zi hái hěn xiǎo
items.en: He didn't marry until he was forty, so his children are still small.
items.why: 才 'not until' with a single event stays a bare verb here, so nothing goes in the blank. 着 marks a continuing state and 过 marks past experience; neither fits one wedding at forty.

items.src_py: tā zuó tiān shí diǎn jiù dào le
items.task: Say it was late: he did not arrive until ten.
items.zh: 他昨天十点才到。
items.py: tā zuó tiān shí diǎn cái dào
items.en: He didn't arrive until ten yesterday.
items.why: Switching to 才 'late' removes 了. 才 follows the time phrase and precedes 到.

items.q: 请问洗手间在哪儿？你看，洗手间___在那儿。
items.zh: 请问洗手间在哪儿？你看，洗手间就在那儿。
items.py: qǐng wèn xǐ shǒu jiān zài nǎ r nǐ kàn xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài nà r
items.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet? It's right over there.
items.why: 就 before 在 points at the spot: 'right over there'. 也 would be 'also over there', and 都 and 再 do not answer a where-question.

items.q: 如果明天下雨，我们___不去公园了。
items.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去公园了。
items.py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù gōng yuán le
items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the park.
items.why: 如果 is answered by 就 in the result clause: if X, then Y. 才 would turn it into a hard-won result, and 又 means 'again'.

items.s: 他才三岁，就会背很多古诗了。
items.s_py: tā cái sān suì jiù huì bèi hěn duō gǔ shī le
items.zh: 他才三岁，就会背很多古诗了。
items.py: tā cái sān suì jiù huì bèi hěn duō gǔ shī le
items.en: He's only three, yet he can already recite many old poems.
items.why: Two uses in one sentence: 才 before the age means 'only three', and 就 ... 了 marks how early the ability is. Both are correct.

items.q: 她___三岁，还不会自己吃饭。
items.zh: 她才三岁，还不会自己吃饭。
items.py: tā cái sān suì hái bú huì zì jǐ chī fàn
items.en: She's only three and can't feed herself yet.
items.why: 才 right before an age means 'only, that's young'. 都 would need 了 and a different mood; 也 and 又 mean 'also' and 'again', not 'only'.

items.q: 只有把基础打好，你以后___能学得更快。
items.zh: 只有把基础打好，你以后才能学得更快。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu bǎ jī chǔ dǎ hǎo nǐ yǐ hòu cái néng xué de gèng kuài
items.en: Only if you build a solid foundation can you learn faster later.
items.why: 只有 is answered by 才: a solid foundation is the one necessary condition. 就 would pair with 只要, and 再 and 还 do not link a condition to its result.

items.q: 这个项目必须由经理决定，只有他同意，我们___能开始。
items.zh: 这个项目必须由经理决定，只有他同意，我们才能开始。
items.py: zhè ge xiàng mù bì xū yóu jīng lǐ jué dìng zhǐ yǒu tā tóng yì wǒ men cái néng kāi shǐ
items.en: This project must be decided by the manager; only if he agrees can we start.
items.why: 只有 is answered by 才: his consent is the one necessary condition. 就 would answer 只要 or 如果, and 也 would add 'also'.

items.zh: 只有多练习才能说得好。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí cái néng shuō de hǎo
items.en: Only by practising a lot can you speak well.
items.why: 只有 opens the condition and 才 stands before 能 in the result clause. 就 would pair with 只要 instead.

items.s: 昨天会开到十一点才结束。
items.s_py: zuó tiān huì kāi dào shí yì diǎn cái jié shù
items.zh: 昨天会开到十一点才结束。
items.py: zuó tiān huì kāi dào shí yī diǎn cái jié shù
items.en: Yesterday's meeting didn't end until eleven.
items.why: 才 after 十一点 marks a late finish, and 了 is not needed with this 'not until' use. Here 才 and 到 work together.

items.q: 昨天会议九点开始，小王九点半___到。
items.zh: 昨天会议九点开始，小王九点半才到。
items.py: zuó tiān huì yì jiǔ diǎn kāi shǐ xiǎo wáng jiǔ diǎn bàn cái dào
items.en: Yesterday the meeting started at nine, and Xiao Wang didn't arrive until half past nine.
items.why: Half past nine is after the start, so he was late: 才, no 了. 就 needs an early time and 了, which would contradict the contrast clause.

items.q: 你要找的那份合同___在你左边的文件夹里，打开看看吧。
items.zh: 你要找的那份合同就在你左边的文件夹里，打开看看吧。
items.py: nǐ yào zhǎo de nà fèn hé tóng jiù zài nǐ zuǒ biān de wén jiàn jiā lǐ dǎ kāi kàn kàn ba
items.en: The contract you're looking for is right there in the folder on your left; open it and see.
items.why: 就 before 在 pinpoints 'right there', matching the instruction to open the folder. 也 would say it is also there, and 都 and 又 do not fit.

items.s: 就我一个人没带词典。
items.s_py: jiù wǒ yí gè rén méi dài cí diǎn
items.zh: 就我一个人没带词典。
items.py: jiù wǒ yí gè rén méi dài cí diǎn
items.en: I'm the only one who didn't bring a dictionary.
items.why: Placing 就 before the person it limits is correct and means 'only me'. It looks wrong because English 'then' sits in front, but here it is the 'only' 就.

items.zh: 如果明天下雨我们就不去了。
items.py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù le
items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
items.why: The condition comes first, then the subject 我们, then 就 before 不去. 就 cannot come before 我们, which would mean 'only we'.

items.q: 只要你把作业交上来，老师___不会批评你。
items.zh: 只要你把作业交上来，老师就不会批评你。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ bǎ zuò yè jiāo shàng lái lǎo shī jiù bú huì pī píng nǐ
items.en: As long as you hand in your homework, the teacher won't criticise you.
items.why: 只要 says handing it in is enough, so the result takes 就. 才 would need 只有, and 再 and 又 mean 'again', so they cannot link a condition to its result.

items.q: 今天开会，___小李没来，其他人都到了。
items.zh: 今天开会，就小李没来，其他人都到了。
items.py: jīn tiān kāi huì jiù xiǎo lǐ méi lái qí tā rén dōu dào le
items.en: At today's meeting only Xiao Li was absent; everyone else was there.
items.why: 就 in front of 小李 singles out the one absentee. 也 would say Xiao Li was also absent, but 其他人都到了 makes him the only one.

items.q: 如果天气好，___我们___去爬山。
items.zh: 如果天气好，我们就去爬山。
items.py: rú guǒ tiān qì hǎo wǒ men jiù qù pá shān
items.en: If the weather's nice, we'll go hiking.
items.why: 就 follows the subject 我们 and sits right before 去: 我们就去. 就我们去 would mean 'only we are going', not 'then we'll go'.

items.s: 老板十点才到，大家八点就来了。
items.s_py: lǎo bǎn shí diǎn cái dào dà jiā bā diǎn jiù lái le
items.zh: 老板十点才到，大家八点就来了。
items.py: lǎo bǎn shí diǎn cái dào dà jiā bā diǎn jiù lái le
items.en: The boss didn't arrive until ten, but everyone had come as early as eight.
items.why: The contrast is deliberate. 才 (no 了) marks the boss as late and 就 ... 了 marks the others as early, so both are correct.

items.q: 现在___七点，你再睡一会儿吧。
items.zh: 现在才七点，你再睡一会儿吧。
items.py: xiàn zài cái qī diǎn nǐ zài shuì yī huì r ba
items.en: It's only seven o'clock now, so sleep a little longer.
items.why: 才 before a clock time says 'only seven, still early', which supports 再睡一会儿. 都 would say 'it's already seven', the opposite message; 也 and 又 do not mean 'only'.

items.s: 我是就李老师。
items.s_py: wǒ shì jiù lǐ lǎo shī
items.zh: 我就是李老师。
items.py: wǒ jiù shì lǐ lǎo shī
items.en: I am Teacher Li.
items.why: 就 must come before 是, never after it. 我是就 is not possible Chinese.

items.q: 他一进门，___大家___安静了。
items.zh: 他一进门，大家就安静了。
items.py: tā yī jìn mén dà jiā jiù ān jìng le
items.en: The moment he came in, everyone fell quiet.
items.why: In 一 A 就 B the 就 follows the second subject 大家, right before 安静. 就大家 would mean 'only everyone', which is not the 'as soon as' meaning.

items.q: 我们公司八点上班，他十点___到公司。
items.zh: 我们公司八点上班，他十点才到公司。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī bā diǎn shàng bān tā shí diǎn cái dào gōng sī
items.en: Our company starts at eight, but he didn't get to the office until ten.
items.why: Ten o'clock is two hours after the start, so the speaker sees it as late: 才, with no 了. 就 would need an early time and a final 了.

items.q: 我___去过一次北京，别的城市都没去过。
items.zh: 我就去过一次北京，别的城市都没去过。
items.py: wǒ jiù qù guo yī cì běi jīng bié de chéng shì dōu méi qù guo
items.en: I've only been to Beijing once and have never been to any other city.
items.why: 就 before the verb with 一次 means 'just once', followed by 别的城市都没去过. 又 and 再 mean 'again', and 都 would contradict 一次.

items.zh: 他一喝酒就脸红。
items.py: tā yī hē jiǔ jiù liǎn hóng
items.en: His face goes red whenever he drinks.
items.why: The habit pattern is Subject + 一 + verb + 就 + result. 一 cannot come before the pronoun 他, and 就 must follow 喝酒, not precede it.

items.s: 只有多读书，你就能写好文章。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu duō dú shū nǐ jiù néng xiě hǎo wén zhāng
items.zh: 只有多读书，你才能写好文章。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duō dú shū nǐ cái néng xiě hǎo wén zhāng
items.en: Only by reading a lot can you write good essays.
items.why: 只有 expresses a necessary condition and is answered by 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

items.q: 要是你明天有空，我___带你去公司看看。
items.zh: 要是你明天有空，我就带你去公司看看。
items.py: yào shì nǐ míng tiān yǒu kòng wǒ jiù dài nǐ qù gōng sī kàn kàn
items.en: If you're free tomorrow, I'll take you to see the company.
items.why: 要是 'if' is answered by 就 in the result clause. 才 would need 只有, and 又 and 都 do not complete a conditional.

items.q: 我们班___小王会开车，其他人都不会。
items.zh: 我们班就小王会开车，其他人都不会。
items.py: wǒ men bān jiù xiǎo wáng huì kāi chē qí tā rén dōu bú huì
items.en: In our class only Xiao Wang can drive; everyone else can't.
items.why: 就 before the person singles him out: 'only Xiao Wang'. 也 would add him to a group and 都 would mean everyone can drive, against 其他人都不会.

items.q: 小王昨天十点才回家___，没吃晚饭。
items.zh: 小王昨天十点才回家，没吃晚饭。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān shí diǎn cái huí jiā méi chī wǎn fàn
items.en: Xiao Wang didn't get home until ten yesterday and skipped dinner.
items.why: 才 'not until' with a time word leaves the verb bare here: 十点才回家. 过 would mean 'has been home before' and 着 a continuing state; neither fits one specific evening.

items.q: 经理一走进办公室，大家___安静下来了。
items.zh: 经理一走进办公室，大家就安静下来了。
items.py: jīng lǐ yī zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì dà jiā jiù ān jìng xià lái le
items.en: As soon as the manager walked into the office, everyone fell quiet.
items.why: 一 A 就 B: everyone went quiet right at his entrance. 才 would mean they stayed noisy until later, and 还 and 又 add nothing to 一.

items.s: 饭吃完了，你能才去玩。
items.s_py: fàn chī wán le nǐ néng cái qù wán
items.zh: 饭吃完了，你才能去玩。
items.py: fàn chī wán le nǐ cái néng qù wán
items.en: You can go out to play only after you've finished eating.
items.why: 才 is an adverb that must stand before the modal 能. Putting it after 能 breaks the word order.

items.s: 咖啡店在就前面。
items.s_py: kā fēi diàn zài jiù qián miàn
items.zh: 咖啡店就在前面。
items.py: kā fēi diàn jiù zài qián miàn
items.en: The café is right ahead.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and must come before 在. It cannot be placed between 在 and the place.

items.q: 经理三点就走___，没等我们开完会。
items.zh: 经理三点就走了，没等我们开完会。
items.py: jīng lǐ sān diǎn jiù zǒu le méi děng wǒ men kāi wán huì
items.en: The manager left as early as three and didn't wait for us to finish the meeting.
items.why: The leaving is a finished past event, and 就 pairs with 了. 过 would be about experience; 着 would describe a state of walking, which is wrong for 走.

items.q: 昨天作业太多，我写到十二点___睡。
items.zh: 昨天作业太多，我写到十二点才睡。
items.py: zuó tiān zuò yè tài duō wǒ xiě dào shí èr diǎn cái shuì
items.en: There was too much homework yesterday, so I didn't go to bed until twelve.
items.why: Midnight after too much homework is late, and 睡 has no 了: 才. 就 would suit an early bedtime with 了.

items.q: 你等一下，我马上___来。
items.zh: 你等一下，我马上就来。
items.py: nǐ děng yí xià wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái
items.en: Hold on, I'll be right there.
items.why: 马上 + 就 means 'right away'. 又 means 'again', 也 means 'also' and 还 means 'still'; none of them combine with 马上.

items.zh: 作业写完了你才能看电视。
items.py: zuò yè xiě wán le nǐ cái néng kàn diàn shì
items.en: You can watch TV only after your homework is done.
items.why: 才 sits before the modal 能, after 你 and the condition. It cannot be moved to the front or after 看电视.

items.q: 你吃完饭，___我们___能出发。
items.zh: 你吃完饭，我们才能出发。
items.py: nǐ chī wán fàn wǒ men cái néng chū fā
items.en: We can set off only after you've finished eating.
items.why: 才 follows the subject 我们 and stands before the modal 能. It cannot sit in front of 我们 the way English 'only then' can.

items.q: 只要你同意，___我___可以帮你。
items.zh: 只要你同意，我就可以帮你。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ tóng yì wǒ jiù kě yǐ bāng nǐ
items.en: As long as you agree, I can help you.
items.why: 就 goes after 我 and before the modal 可以. Putting 就 before 我 would say 'only I can help you', which changes the meaning.

items.s: 这件衣服五十块钱才，很便宜。
items.s_py: zhè jiàn yī fu wǔ shí kuài qián cái hěn pián yi
items.zh: 这件衣服才五十块钱，很便宜。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu cái wǔ shí kuài qián hěn pián yi
items.en: This shirt is only fifty kuai; it's cheap.
items.why: 才 meaning 'only' goes directly before the amount. It cannot follow the price at the end of the clause.

items.q: 我今天七点就到学校___，教室里还没有人。
items.zh: 我今天七点就到学校了，教室里还没有人。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān qī diǎn jiù dào xué xiào le jiào shì lǐ hái méi yǒu rén
items.en: I got to school as early as seven today, and there is nobody in the classroom yet.
items.why: One finished arrival with 就 takes 了. 过 says 'have been there before' and 着 describes a continuing state; neither reports today's arrival.

items.q: 他昨天晚上___十一点___回家。
items.zh: 他昨天晚上十一点才回家。
items.py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shàng shí yī diǎn cái huí jiā
items.en: He didn't get home until eleven last night.
items.why: The time phrase 十一点 comes first and 才 follows it, right before 回家. 才十一点 would mean 'only eleven' as the time itself.

items.s: 我们要找的李老师就在楼上。
items.s_py: wǒ men yào zhǎo de lǐ lǎo shī jiù zài lóu shàng
items.zh: 我们要找的李老师就在楼上。
items.py: wǒ men yào zhǎo de lǐ lǎo shī jiù zài lóu shàng
items.en: Teacher Li, who we're looking for, is right upstairs.
items.why: 就 stands before 在 and means 'right there'. After 在 it would be ungrammatical.

items.q: 他一喝酒___脸红，所以从来不喝。
items.zh: 他一喝酒就脸红，所以从来不喝。
items.py: tā yī hē jiǔ jiù liǎn hóng suǒ yǐ cóng lái bù hē
items.en: He goes red whenever he drinks, so he never drinks.
items.why: 一 A 就 B also states a habit: every time he drinks, his face reddens. 才 would add a delay, and 也 and 还 do not link a cause and result.

items.q: 公司里___他一个人会说日语，所以翻译都找他。
items.zh: 公司里就他一个人会说日语，所以翻译都找他。
items.py: gōng sī lǐ jiù tā yí gè rén huì shuō rì yǔ suǒ yǐ fān yì dōu zhǎo tā
items.en: Only he in the company speaks Japanese, so everyone asks him to translate.
items.why: 就 in front of 他一个人 limits the ability to him alone, which is why everyone asks him. 也 and 还 add people; 都 cannot go before a single person.

items.s: 你不把作业写完，我就不让你出去玩。
items.s_py: nǐ bù bǎ zuò yè xiě wán wǒ jiù bù ràng nǐ chū qù wán
items.zh: 你不把作业写完，我就不让你出去玩。
items.py: nǐ bù bǎ zuò yè xiě wán wǒ jiù bù ràng nǐ chū qù wán
items.en: If you don't finish your homework, I won't let you go out to play.
items.why: 就 follows 我 and comes before 不让, as the result of the 不 condition. It does not mean 'only I'.

items.q: 只要你努力，你___能学好。
items.zh: 只要你努力，你就能学好。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ nǔ lì nǐ jiù néng xué hǎo
items.en: As long as you work hard, you can learn it well.
items.why: 只要 'as long as' says the condition is enough, so it is answered by 就. 才 belongs to 只有, the only-if condition.

items.s: 只有你同意，我才去。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì wǒ cái qù
items.zh: 只有你同意，我才去。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì wǒ cái qù
items.en: I'll go only if you agree.
items.why: 只有 pairs with 才, which comes after the second subject. The 了-free form is right because this is a condition, not a finished event.

items.s: 她一紧张才说不出话。
items.s_py: tā yī jǐn zhāng cái shuō bù chū huà
items.zh: 她一紧张就说不出话。
items.py: tā yī jǐn zhāng jiù shuō bù chū huà
items.en: She can't get a word out whenever she's nervous.
items.why: In 一 A 就 B the second verb needs 就. 才 means 'late' and cannot answer 一.

items.q: 他从小爱读书，八岁___读完了《西游记》。
items.zh: 他从小爱读书，八岁就读完了《西游记》。
items.py: tā cóng xiǎo ài dú shū bā suì jiù dú wán le xī yóu jì
items.en: He loved reading from childhood and had already finished Journey to the West at eight.
items.why: Reading a long novel at eight, after loving books from small, is early and impressive: 就 with 了. 才 would mean eight was late for it.

items.q: 经理说十点开会，同事们九点___来了。
items.zh: 经理说十点开会，同事们九点就来了。
items.py: jīng lǐ shuō shí diǎn kāi huì tóng shì men jiǔ diǎn jiù lái le
items.en: The manager said the meeting is at ten, and my colleagues came as early as nine.
items.why: Nine is an hour before the meeting, so early: 就 plus 了. 才 would say they arrived late, but nine is not late for a ten o'clock meeting.

items.src: 只要你多练习，就能说好。
items.src_py: zhǐ yào nǐ duō liàn xí jiù néng shuō hǎo
items.task: Change it to 'only if' with 只有.
items.zh: 只有你多练习才能说好。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ duō liàn xí cái néng shuō hǎo
items.en: Only if you practise a lot can you speak well.
items.why: 只有 changes the pair from 只要 … 就 to 只有 … 才. 就 must be replaced; leaving 就 would mix the two patterns.

items.q: 学生们一听到下课铃响，___马上跑出了教室。
items.zh: 学生们一听到下课铃响，就马上跑出了教室。
items.py: xué shēng men yī tīng dào xià kè líng xiǎng jiù mǎ shàng pǎo chū le jiào shì
items.en: As soon as the students heard the bell, they ran out of the classroom at once.
items.why: 一 + 听到 is answered by 就 before the next action, and 马上 already confirms immediacy. 才 would say they waited, and 也 and 又 do not complete 一.

items.q: 因为系统一直出问题，我们改了一个星期，客户的资料___整理完。
items.zh: 因为系统一直出问题，我们改了一个星期，客户的资料才整理完。
items.py: yīn wèi xì tǒng yì zhí chū wèn tí wǒ men gǎi le yí gè xīng qī kè hù de zī liào cái zhěng lǐ wán
items.en: Because the system kept breaking, it took us a week of fixes before the client's files were sorted out.
items.why: 一直出问题 and a whole week show it was hard-won, and 整理完 has no 了: 才. 就 would need a quick, easy job.

items.zh: 小李今天中午一点才吃午饭。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ jīn tiān zhōng wǔ yī diǎn cái chī wǔ fàn
items.en: Xiao Li didn't have lunch until one o'clock today.
items.why: 才 follows the time phrase it comments on and comes right before 吃午饭, with no 了. The time may come before or after 小李, but 才 may not precede either.

items.q: 老师一讲，我就听懂___。
items.zh: 老师一讲，我就听懂了。
items.py: lǎo shī yī jiǎng wǒ jiù tīng dǒng le
items.en: As soon as the teacher explained it, I understood.
items.why: A single completed event after 一…就 takes 了: 听懂了. 过 would mean 'have understood before' and 着 cannot follow a result like 懂.

items.zh: 只要你努力我们就能赢。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ nǔ lì wǒ men jiù néng yíng
items.en: As long as you work hard, we can win.
items.why: 只要 clause first, then 我们, then 就 before the modal 能. 就 cannot precede 我们 without changing the meaning to 'only we'.

items.q: 电影七点开始，他六点半___到了。
items.zh: 电影七点开始，他六点半就到了。
items.py: diàn yǐng qī diǎn kāi shǐ tā liù diǎn bàn jiù dào le
items.en: The film starts at seven, and he was already there by half past six.
items.why: Arriving at 6:30 for a 7:00 film is early, and the final 了 marks a finished event: 就 ... 了. 才 would mean he was late, which clashes with the contrast clause.

items.q: 虽然路上堵车，但是司机很熟悉这一带，二十分钟___把我们送到了机场。
items.zh: 虽然路上堵车，但是司机很熟悉这一带，二十分钟就把我们送到了机场。
items.py: suī rán lù shàng dǔ chē dàn shì sī jī hěn shú xī zhè yī dài èr shí fēn zhōng jiù bǎ wǒ men sòng dào le jī chǎng
items.en: Although the traffic was bad, the driver knew the area well and got us to the airport in just twenty minutes.
items.why: 虽然 sets up a delay, and 但是 turns it round: twenty minutes is quick. 就 with 了 fits. 才 would carry on the idea of a slow trip.

items.q: 这份报告不难，小李两个小时___写好了。
items.zh: 这份报告不难，小李两个小时就写好了。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào bù nán xiǎo lǐ liǎng gè xiǎo shí jiù xiě hǎo le
items.en: The report isn't hard; Xiao Li finished writing it in just two hours.
items.why: The report is easy and two hours is short, so 就 with 了. 才 would imply a long, hard job, which 不难 rules out.

items.task: Say he came already at eight, earlier than expected (use 就).
items.zh: 他八点就来了。
items.py: tā bā diǎn jiù lái le
items.en: He came as early as eight.
items.why: 就 follows the time 八点 and stays before 来, and 了 stays at the end. 就 must not start the sentence or follow 来了.

items.q: 我一到公司___给你发邮件。
items.zh: 我一到公司就给你发邮件。
items.py: wǒ yī dào gōng sī jiù gěi nǐ fā yóu jiàn
items.en: I'll email you as soon as I get to the office.
items.why: 一到公司 sets the trigger and the reply pattern is 就 + verb. 才 would mean 'only then', a delay, and 也 and 还 cannot complete 一.

items.q: 他昨天晚上十一点才睡___，今天起不来。
items.zh: 他昨天晚上十一点才睡，今天起不来。
items.py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shàng shí yī diǎn cái shuì jīn tiān qǐ bù lái
items.en: He didn't go to bed until eleven last night, so he can't get up today.
items.why: 才 'not until' leaves 睡 bare: 十一点才睡. 过 would mean 'has ever slept', which makes no sense here, and 了 belongs with 就, not with 才.

items.q: 她还没毕业，公司就给她发___录用通知。
items.zh: 她还没毕业，公司就给她发了录用通知。
items.py: tā hái méi bì yè gōng sī jiù gěi tā fā le lù yòng tōng zhī
items.en: She hadn't even graduated when the company had already sent her an offer letter.
items.why: 就 marks how early this was, and the sending is one finished act with an object, so 了 follows 发. 过 would suggest she had received one before; 着 fits no sending.

items.q: 你___不告诉我，我___没办法帮你。
items.zh: 你如果不告诉我，我就没办法帮你。
items.py: nǐ rú guǒ bù gào sù wǒ wǒ jiù méi bàn fǎ bāng nǐ
items.en: If you don't tell me, I have no way to help you.
items.why: 如果 pairs with 就 for a plain 'if ... then'. 只要 ... 才 and 只有 ... 就 mix the two condition words with the wrong adverb; 因为 ... 所以 gives a cause, not a condition.

items.q: 他___五岁，已经会用电脑了。
items.zh: 他才五岁，已经会用电脑了。
items.py: tā cái wǔ suì yǐ jīng huì yòng diàn nǎo le
items.en: He's only five, yet he already knows how to use a computer.
items.why: 才 + age = 'only five', setting up the surprise of 已经. 也 would mean 'also five' and 又 and 再 mean 'again'.

items.q: 这篇课文太难了，老师讲了三遍，我___听懂。
items.zh: 这篇课文太难了，老师讲了三遍，我才听懂。
items.py: zhè piān kè wén tài nán le lǎo shī jiǎng le sān biàn wǒ cái tīng dǒng
items.en: This text was so hard that I only understood it after the teacher explained it three times.
items.why: 太难了 and three explanations show effort, and there is no 了: 才. 就 would suit one explanation and an easy text.

items.q: 儿子___上一年级，作业不多。
items.zh: 儿子才上一年级，作业不多。
items.py: ér zi cái shàng yī nián jí zuò yè bù duō
items.en: My son is only in the first year, so there is not much homework.
items.why: 才 before a school year means "only", young. 都 wants 了 and says "already", 也 means "also", and 再 means "again".

items.q: 妈妈一说要去商场，女儿___高兴得跳了起来。
items.zh: 妈妈一说要去商场，女儿就高兴得跳了起来。
items.py: mā ma yī shuō yào qù shāng chǎng nǚ ér jiù gāo xìng de tiào le qǐ lái
items.en: As soon as Mum said they were going to the mall, my daughter jumped for joy.
items.why: 一说…就 means the reaction came the moment she heard it. 才 means late and 也 means "also", so neither completes 一.

items.s: 如果你不舒服，我们回家就吧。
items.s_py: rú guǒ nǐ bù shū fu wǒ men huí jiā jiù ba
items.zh: 如果你不舒服，我们就回家吧。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ bù shū fu wǒ men jiù huí jiā ba
items.en: If you're not feeling well, let's go home.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and must stand right before its verb 回家. Placing it after the verb, as in 回家就吧, is not possible Chinese.

items.s: 就我弟弟一个人没来，别人都到了。
items.s_py: jiù wǒ dì di yī gè rén méi lái bié rén dōu dào le
items.zh: 就我弟弟一个人没来，别人都到了。
items.py: jiù wǒ dì di yī gè rén méi lái bié rén dōu dào le
items.en: Only my younger brother did not come; everyone else is here.
items.why: Sentence-initial 就 before a person means "only that person", so this is correct, even though 就 before the subject looks odd.

items.zh: 爸爸一下班就去超市买菜。
items.py: bà ba yī xià bān jiù qù chāo shì mǎi cài
items.en: As soon as Dad finishes work he goes to the supermarket to buy food.
items.why: 一 sits before the first verb and 就 before the second, each right in front of its own verb after the shared subject.

items.q: 她___三岁，还不会说话。
items.zh: 她才三岁，还不会说话。
items.py: tā cái sān suì hái bù huì shuō huà
items.en: She's only three and can't talk yet.
items.why: 才 directly before an age means "only", young. 都 and 已经 stress that it is a lot, the opposite of "only", and 也 means "also".

items.q: 哥哥一到家，___给我打电话。
items.zh: 哥哥一到家，就给我打电话。
items.py: gē ge yī dào jiā jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: As soon as my brother gets home he will phone me.
items.why: 一到家…就 means the call comes immediately after arriving. 才 means late and contradicts 一.

items.q: 你问我家在哪儿？这儿___是我家。
items.zh: 你问我家在哪儿？这儿就是我家。
items.py: nǐ wèn wǒ jiā zài nǎ r zhè r jiù shì wǒ jiā
items.en: You ask where my home is? This right here is my home.
items.why: 就 before 是 pins down "right here". 也 would mean "this is also my home", not an answer to where it is.

items.q: 我现在___给你转钱，你看一下手机。
items.zh: 我现在就给你转钱，你看一下手机。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài jiù gěi nǐ zhuǎn qián nǐ kàn yī xià shǒu jī
items.en: I'll transfer you the money right now, so check your phone.
items.why: 现在 plus 就 means "right now". 再 would postpone the transfer, which clashes with 现在 and with checking the phone.

items.s: 这条裤子才八十块，我就买了两条。
items.s_py: zhè tiáo kù zi cái bā shí kuài wǒ jiù mǎi le liǎng tiáo
items.zh: 这条裤子才八十块，我就买了两条。
items.py: zhè tiáo kù zi cái bā shí kuài wǒ jiù mǎi le liǎng tiáo
items.en: These trousers are only eighty kuai, so I bought two pairs.
items.why: 才 before the price means "only", and 就买了 shows the quick decision that followed. Both are correct here.

items.q: 超市很近，走路五分钟___到了。
items.zh: 超市很近，走路五分钟就到了。
items.py: chāo shì hěn jìn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le
items.en: The supermarket is close; it's only a five-minute walk.
items.why: Close plus five minutes means quick and easy: 就, with 了 at the end. 才 would say the walk took a long time, which contradicts 很近.

items.q: 电视剧八点开始，女儿六点___坐在沙发上等了。
items.zh: 电视剧八点开始，女儿六点就坐在沙发上等了。
items.py: diàn shì jù bā diǎn kāi shǐ nǚ ér liù diǎn jiù zuò zài shā fā shàng děng le
items.en: The drama starts at eight, but my daughter was already sitting on the sofa waiting at six.
items.why: Six is two hours before the start, so she was early: 就. 才 means late and cannot describe a time before the start.

items.q: 妈妈今天早上六点就起床___，给我们做早饭。
items.zh: 妈妈今天早上六点就起床了，给我们做早饭。
items.py: mā ma jīn tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le gěi wǒ men zuò zǎo fàn
items.en: Mum got up as early as six this morning to make us breakfast.
items.why: Getting up this morning is one finished event, so 就 takes 了. 着 and 过 cannot mark a completed action in a story like this.

items.q: 这个商店___卖水果，别的东西都没有。
items.zh: 这个商店就卖水果，别的东西都没有。
items.py: zhè ge shāng diàn jiù mài shuǐ guǒ bié de dōng xi dōu méi yǒu
items.en: This shop only sells fruit; it has nothing else.
items.why: 就 before 卖 means "only sells". 还 and 也 mean "also", which the next clause (nothing else) rules out.

items.zh: 洗手间就在厨房旁边。
items.py: xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài chú fáng páng biān
items.en: The bathroom is right next to the kitchen.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and goes before 在. It cannot come between 在 and the place.

items.q: 只有存够了钱，我们___能买房子。
items.zh: 只有存够了钱，我们才能买房子。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu cún gòu le qián wǒ men cái néng mǎi fáng zi
items.en: Only when we have saved enough money can we buy a house.
items.why: 只有 states the one required condition and takes 才, usually followed by 能. 就 pairs with 只要 or 如果.

items.s: 我马上才来，你等一下。
items.s_py: wǒ mǎ shàng cái lái nǐ děng yī xià
items.zh: 我马上就来，你等一下。
items.py: wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái nǐ děng yī xià
items.en: I'll be right there, wait a moment.
items.why: 马上 means "right away" and pairs with 就. 才 means late, which contradicts 马上.

items.q: 这条裙子很便宜，妈妈看了一眼___买了。
items.zh: 这条裙子很便宜，妈妈看了一眼就买了。
items.py: zhè tiáo qún zi hěn pián yi mā ma kàn le yī yǎn jiù mǎi le
items.en: The skirt was cheap, and Mum bought it after just one look.
items.why: One glance and a purchase is little effort, so 就 (which also goes with the final 了). 才 would mean she needed a lot of effort first.

items.q: 只要你不乱花钱，每个月___能存下一千块。
items.zh: 只要你不乱花钱，每个月就能存下一千块。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ bù luàn huā qián měi gè yuè jiù néng cún xià yī qiān kuài
items.en: As long as you don't spend wildly, you can save a thousand kuai a month.
items.why: 只要 means the condition is enough, so the result takes 就. 才 would need 只有 in the first half.

items.q: 你找李老师吗？我___是。
items.zh: 你找李老师吗？我就是。
items.py: nǐ zhǎo lǐ lǎo shī ma wǒ jiù shì
items.en: Are you looking for Teacher Li? That is me.
items.why: 就 before 是 means "precisely", so "I am the one". 也 would mean "me too", which does not answer the question.

items.q: 姐姐二十岁就结婚___，现在孩子都上学了。
items.zh: 姐姐二十岁就结婚了，现在孩子都上学了。
items.py: jiě jie èr shí suì jiù jié hūn le xiàn zài hái zi dōu shàng xué le
items.en: My sister got married at twenty, and now her child is already at school.
items.why: Getting married at twenty is a completed event, so 就 takes 了. 着 gives a continuing state, and 的 would need 是 in front to work.

items.q: 儿子一回家___要吃饭。
items.zh: 儿子一回家就要吃饭。
items.py: ér zi yī huí jiā jiù yào chī fàn
items.en: As soon as my son gets home he wants to eat.
items.why: 一…就 means the second action follows right after the first. 才 means late and 也 means "also", so neither completes 一.

items.q: 只有多看书，___能学好中文。
items.zh: 只有多看书，才能学好中文。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duō kàn shū cái néng xué hǎo zhōng wén
items.en: Only by reading a lot can you learn Chinese well.
items.why: 只有 names the one necessary condition and pairs with 才. 就 pairs with 只要 or 如果, not 只有.

items.q: 他们存了整整五年钱，___买得起一套小房子。
items.zh: 他们存了整整五年钱，才买得起一套小房子。
items.py: tā men cún le zhěng zhěng wǔ nián qián cái mǎi de qǐ yī tào xiǎo fáng zi
items.en: They saved for five whole years before they could afford a small flat.
items.why: Five whole years is a long haul, so the result is hard-won: 才. 就 would make five years sound short, which 整整 rules out.

items.q: 她五岁___会游泳了，真厉害。
items.zh: 她五岁就会游泳了，真厉害。
items.py: tā wǔ suì jiù huì yóu yǒng le zhēn lì hài
items.en: She could already swim at five, which is impressive.
items.why: The number comes before the adverb and 厉害 praises her, so five is early: 就, with 了. 才 would mean not until five and cannot take this 了.

items.q: 我钱包里___有十块钱，不够买这个。
items.zh: 我钱包里就有十块钱，不够买这个。
items.py: wǒ qián bāo lǐ jiù yǒu shí kuài qián bù gòu mǎi zhè ge
items.en: I only have ten kuai in my wallet, which isn't enough to buy this.
items.why: 就 before 有 plus a small amount means "only". 也 means "also", 还 means "still" and 再 means "again", none of which explain not having enough.

items.q: ___孩子写完作业，他___能看电视，这是我们家的规矩。
items.zh: 只有孩子写完作业，他才能看电视，这是我们家的规矩。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu hái zi xiě wán zuò yè tā cái néng kàn diàn shì zhè shì wǒ men jiā de guī ju
items.en: The child can only watch TV once his homework is done; that is our house rule.
items.why: The house rule is "only after homework", so 只有…才. 只有…就, 只要…才 and 如果…才 all pair the conjunction with the wrong adverb.

items.s: 只有打折的时候，姐姐才买衣服。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu dǎ zhé de shí hou jiě jie cái mǎi yī fu
items.zh: 只有打折的时候，姐姐才买衣服。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu dǎ zhé de shí hou jiě jie cái mǎi yī fu
items.en: My sister buys clothes only when they are on sale.
items.why: 只有…才 is the right pair for a single necessary condition, and 才 follows the subject 姐姐.

items.q: 哥哥很能干，一个晚上___把房间整理好了。
items.zh: 哥哥很能干，一个晚上就把房间整理好了。
items.py: gē ge hěn néng gàn yī gè wǎn shang jiù bǎ fáng jiān zhěng lǐ hǎo le
items.en: My brother is capable; he tidied the whole room in a single evening.
items.why: Being capable makes one evening count as quick: 就, with 了. 才 would mean it took too long, which clashes with 很能干.

items.s: 他五岁才会说话，妈妈那时很着急。
items.s_py: tā wǔ suì cái huì shuō huà mā ma nà shí hěn zháo jí
items.zh: 他五岁才会说话，妈妈那时很着急。
items.py: tā wǔ suì cái huì shuō huà mā ma nà shí hěn zháo jí
items.en: He didn't talk until he was five, and Mum was very worried then.
items.why: A number before 才 means "not until", and no 了 is needed. This is correct and fits Mum being worried.

items.q: 妹妹一看见妈妈___哭了。
items.zh: 妹妹一看见妈妈就哭了。
items.py: mèi mei yī kàn jiàn mā ma jiù kū le
items.en: As soon as my sister saw Mum, she burst into tears.
items.why: 一看见…就哭了 means she cried the moment she saw her. 才 would mean late, the opposite of 一.

items.q: 她昨天十点___到家___，我们等了她很久。
items.zh: 她昨天十点才到家，我们等了她很久。
items.py: tā zuó tiān shí diǎn cái dào jiā wǒ men děng le tā hěn jiǔ
items.en: She did not get home until ten yesterday; we waited for her for ages.
items.why: Waiting ages means ten was late: 才, and 才 meaning "not until" takes no 了. 就 with 了 would make ten sound early, against 等了很久.

items.q: 要是你喜欢，我___给你买。
items.zh: 要是你喜欢，我就给你买。
items.py: yào shì nǐ xǐ huan wǒ jiù gěi nǐ mǎi
items.en: If you like it, I'll buy it for you.
items.why: 要是 means "if", and the result takes 就. 才 would need 只有 in the first half.

items.zh: 爷爷今天早上五点就出门了。
items.py: yé ye jīn tiān zǎo shang wǔ diǎn jiù chū mén le
items.en: Grandpa went out as early as five this morning.
items.why: Five is early, so 就 follows the time and precedes the verb, with 了 at the end. 就 cannot come before the time or after 出门.

items.q: 奶奶做饭很快，半个小时___做好了四个菜。
items.zh: 奶奶做饭很快，半个小时就做好了四个菜。
items.py: nǎi nai zuò fàn hěn kuài bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù zuò hǎo le sì gè cài
items.en: Grandma cooks fast; she had four dishes ready in just half an hour.
items.why: Fast cooking makes half an hour short, so 就, with 了 after 做好. 才 would call it slow, against 很快.

items.q: 女儿三岁就认识很多字___。
items.zh: 女儿三岁就认识很多字了。
items.py: nǚ ér sān suì jiù rèn shi hěn duō zì le
items.en: My daughter already knew lots of characters at three.
items.why: 就 with an early age marks an achieved state, and 了 closes it. 着 and 过 cannot say the state has been reached.

items.src_py: nǐ xǐ huan wǒ gěi nǐ mǎi
items.task: Rewrite with 只要 (as long as ...).
items.zh: 只要你喜欢我就给你买。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ xǐ huan wǒ jiù gěi nǐ mǎi
items.en: As long as you like it, I'll buy it for you.
items.why: 只要 opens the condition and the result takes 就 before its verb. 才 would need 只有 instead.

items.q: 银行___在超市旁边，很好找。
items.zh: 银行就在超市旁边，很好找。
items.py: yín háng jiù zài chāo shì páng biān hěn hǎo zhǎo
items.en: The bank is right next to the supermarket, so it's easy to find.
items.why: 就 before 在 means "right there", which is why it is easy to find. 也 would mean the bank is also next to the supermarket.

items.q: 这台电视机___两千块，太便宜了，我们买吧。
items.zh: 这台电视机才两千块，太便宜了，我们买吧。
items.py: zhè tái diàn shì jī cái liǎng qiān kuài tài pián yi le wǒ men mǎi ba
items.en: This TV is only two thousand kuai, so cheap, let's buy it.
items.why: 才 before a price means "only that much", which fits 太便宜了. 都 would make the price sound like a lot.

items.q: 弟弟三岁___会走路，奶奶那时很担心。
items.zh: 弟弟三岁才会走路，奶奶那时很担心。
items.py: dì di sān suì cái huì zǒu lù nǎi nai nà shí hěn dān xīn
items.en: My younger brother didn't walk until he was three, and Grandma was worried then.
items.why: The number comes before the adverb, so the pattern is "not until three": 才. 就 would mean he walked as early as three, but then Grandma would not be worried.

items.q: 你等我一下，我马上___来。
items.zh: 你等我一下，我马上就来。
items.py: nǐ děng wǒ yī xià wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái
items.en: Wait a moment, I'll be right there.
items.why: 马上 plus 就 means "right away". 再 would mean "come again", which does not fit an immediate arrival.

items.zh: 妹妹才三岁。
items.py: mèi mei cái sān suì
items.en: My younger sister is only three.
items.why: 才 goes directly before the age to mean "only". With the age first the meaning would become "not until three".

items.s: 只有多存钱，就能买房子。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu duō cún qián jiù néng mǎi fáng zi
items.zh: 只有多存钱，才能买房子。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duō cún qián cái néng mǎi fáng zi
items.en: Only by saving a lot can you buy a house.
items.why: 只有 pairs with 才, never with 就. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

items.q: 我___去过一次那家商场，不太熟。
items.zh: 我就去过一次那家商场，不太熟。
items.py: wǒ jiù qù guò yī cì nà jiā shāng chǎng bù tài shú
items.en: I've only been to that mall once, so I don't know it well.
items.why: 就 before a verb with a small amount means "only once". 还 would mean "also been", which does not explain not knowing it.

items.q: 客人七点才到，可是妈妈四点就开始做饭___。
items.zh: 客人七点才到，可是妈妈四点就开始做饭了。
items.py: kè rén qī diǎn cái dào kě shì mā ma sì diǎn jiù kāi shǐ zuò fàn le
items.en: The guests only arrived at seven, but Mum had started cooking at four.
items.why: The contrast is 才 with no 了 (late) against 就 with 了 (early). 着 and 过 cannot mark that cooking began.

items.s: 哥哥昨天早上七点出门就了。
items.s_py: gē ge zuó tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn chū mén jiù le
items.zh: 哥哥昨天早上七点就出门了。
items.py: gē ge zuó tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn jiù chū mén le
items.en: My brother went out as early as seven yesterday morning.
items.why: 就 is placed before the verb, not after it. Only 了 goes at the end.

items.s: 只有你同意，才我告诉你。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì cái wǒ gào su nǐ
items.zh: 只有你同意，我才告诉你。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì wǒ cái gào su nǐ
items.en: I will tell you only if you agree.
items.why: 才 goes after the subject 我 and before the verb. It cannot open the clause the way English "then" does.

items.s: 电影七点开始，弟弟五点半就到电影院了。
items.s_py: diàn yǐng qī diǎn kāi shǐ dì di wǔ diǎn bàn jiù dào diàn yǐng yuàn le
items.zh: 电影七点开始，弟弟五点半就到电影院了。
items.py: diàn yǐng qī diǎn kāi shǐ dì di wǔ diǎn bàn jiù dào diàn yǐng yuàn le
items.en: The film starts at seven, but my younger brother was already at the cinema at half past five.
items.why: Half past five is well before the start, so 就, and one finished event takes 了. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 这家店卖就水果。
items.s_py: zhè jiā diàn mài jiù shuǐ guǒ
items.zh: 这家店就卖水果。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn jiù mài shuǐ guǒ
items.en: This shop only sells fruit.
items.why: 就 meaning "only" must come before the verb 卖. After the verb it is not a possible sentence.

items.q: ___妈妈同意，爸爸___不会反对。
items.zh: 只要妈妈同意，爸爸就不会反对。
items.py: zhǐ yào mā ma tóng yì bà ba jiù bù huì fǎn duì
items.en: As long as Mum agrees, Dad won't object.
items.why: "As long as" is 只要…就. 只有…才 means "only if", a different meaning, and 只要…才 and 只有…就 are mismatched pairs.

items.q: 如果你不想自己做饭，我们___叫外卖吧。
items.zh: 如果你不想自己做饭，我们就叫外卖吧。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ bù xiǎng zì jǐ zuò fàn wǒ men jiù jiào wài mài ba
items.en: If you don't feel like cooking, let's order takeaway.
items.why: 如果 introduces the condition and the suggestion takes 就. 才 needs 只有, and 又 means "again".

items.q: 爸爸找了半天___找到钥匙。
items.zh: 爸爸找了半天才找到钥匙。
items.py: bà ba zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào yào shi
items.en: Dad searched for ages before he found the keys.
items.why: Searching for ages means the result came late and with effort: 才, with no 了. 就 would say he found them at once, which clashes with 半天.

items.q: 弟弟昨天晚上十一点___睡，今天起不来。
items.zh: 弟弟昨天晚上十一点才睡，今天起不来。
items.py: dì di zuó tiān wǎn shang shí yī diǎn cái shuì jīn tiān qǐ bù lái
items.en: My younger brother didn't go to bed until eleven last night, so he can't get up today.
items.why: He cannot get up, so eleven was late for bedtime: 才. 就 would make eleven sound early and clash with the second clause.

items.q: 我们小区那么多人，___隔壁的张奶奶会说英语。
items.zh: 我们小区那么多人，就隔壁的张奶奶会说英语。
items.py: wǒ men xiǎo qū nà me duō rén jiù gé bì de zhāng nǎi nai huì shuō yīng yǔ
items.en: Among all the people in our complex, only Grandma Zhang next door speaks English.
items.why: 就 before the person singles out one from many. 都 and 也 cannot mean "only" and would not suit 那么多人.

items.s: 他一看价钱，就把衣服放下了。
items.s_py: tā yī kàn jià qián jiù bǎ yī fu fàng xià le
items.zh: 他一看价钱，就把衣服放下了。
items.py: tā yī kàn jià qián jiù bǎ yī fu fàng xià le
items.en: As soon as he saw the price, he put the clothes back.
items.why: 一…就 for one finished event takes 了 at the end, and 就 sits before 把. It is correct.

items.s: 这个西瓜十块钱才，太便宜了。
items.s_py: zhè ge xī guā shí kuài qián cái tài pián yi le
items.zh: 这个西瓜才十块钱，太便宜了。
items.py: zhè ge xī guā cái shí kuài qián tài pián yi le
items.en: This watermelon is only ten kuai, so cheap!
items.why: 才 meaning "only" goes before the number, not after it. Nothing can follow the price this way.

items.q: 我们家___爸爸会做饭。
items.zh: 我们家就爸爸会做饭。
items.py: wǒ men jiā jiù bà ba huì zuò fàn
items.en: In our family only Dad can cook.
items.why: 就 before a person means "only that person". 也, 还 and 都 cannot be put before 爸爸 to mean "only".

items.q: 这个菜很好做，我看一遍___会了。
items.zh: 这个菜很好做，我看一遍就会了。
items.py: zhè ge cài hěn hǎo zuò wǒ kàn yī biàn jiù huì le
items.en: This dish is easy to make; I had learned it after watching just once.
items.why: Easy dish plus one viewing is little effort, so 就, with 了 after 会. 才 would mean it took many tries.

items.s: 你不买，我就不买。
items.s_py: nǐ bù mǎi wǒ jiù bù mǎi
items.zh: 你不买，我就不买。
items.py: nǐ bù mǎi wǒ jiù bù mǎi
items.en: If you don't buy it, I won't either.
items.why: 就 sits after the subject 我 and before 不买, exactly where it belongs.

items.s: 我才买了一件，别的还没看呢。
items.s_py: wǒ cái mǎi le yī jiàn bié de hái méi kàn ne
items.zh: 我才买了一件，别的还没看呢。
items.py: wǒ cái mǎi le yī jiàn bié de hái méi kàn ne
items.en: I've only bought one so far; I haven't looked at the rest yet.
items.why: 才 plus a counted amount means "only", and 了 after the verb is fine. The "no 了 with 才" rule applies to "not until", not to this.

items.task: Say that he did not get home until ten (it was late).
items.zh: 他十点才到家。
items.py: tā shí diǎn cái dào jiā
items.en: He didn't get home until ten.
items.why: Late means 才 after the time and before the verb, with no 了. 就 would make ten sound early.

items.s: 哥哥一下班才给我打电话。
items.s_py: gē ge yī xià bān cái gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
items.zh: 哥哥一下班就给我打电话。
items.py: gē ge yī xià bān jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: As soon as my brother gets off work, he phones me.
items.why: 一…就 means the second action follows at once. 才 means late and cannot complete 一.

items.q: 洗手间___在那边，你看见了吗？
items.zh: 洗手间就在那边，你看见了吗？
items.py: xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài nà biān nǐ kàn jiàn le ma
items.en: The toilet is right over there, can you see it?
items.why: 就 before 在 means "right there", pointing it out. 也 means "also" and 再 means "again", neither of which points anything out.

items.q: 我昨天九点就睡___。
items.zh: 我昨天九点就睡了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān jiǔ diǎn jiù shuì le
items.en: I went to bed as early as nine yesterday.
items.why: One finished event with 就 needs 了 at the end. 过 would describe a past experience, not a single bedtime yesterday.

items.q: 他昨天八点___来___，太早了，我还没起床。
items.zh: 他昨天八点就来了，太早了，我还没起床。
items.py: tā zuó tiān bā diǎn jiù lái le tài zǎo le wǒ hái méi qǐ chuáng
items.en: He came as early as eight yesterday, so early that I was still in bed.
items.why: 太早了 makes eight early, so 就, and a single event yesterday needs 了. 才 means late, and 就 without 了 sounds like a plan or habit, not yesterday.

items.q: 如果明天下雨，我们___不去商场了。
items.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去商场了。
items.py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù shāng chǎng le
items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the mall.
items.why: 如果 introduces a condition and the result takes 就. 才 needs 只有 in the first half, and there is none here.

items.q: 这本书___五块钱，真便宜。
items.zh: 这本书才五块钱，真便宜。
items.py: zhè běn shū cái wǔ kuài qián zhēn pián yi
items.en: This book is only five kuai, how cheap!
items.why: 才 before a price means "only that much". 都 and 也 do not mean "only", and 又 means "again", so none fit a cheap price.

items.q: 我问了三次，儿子___告诉我他的成绩。
items.zh: 我问了三次，儿子才告诉我他的成绩。
items.py: wǒ wèn le sān cì ér zi cái gào su wǒ tā de chéng jì
items.en: I asked three times before my son told me his results.
items.why: Asking three times shows it was hard to get the answer: 才. 就 would mean he answered at once, which clashes with 三次.

items.q: 哥哥十点___回来___，妈妈等得都睡着了。
items.zh: 哥哥十点才回来，妈妈等得都睡着了。
items.py: gē ge shí diǎn cái huí lái mā ma děng de dōu shuì zháo le
items.en: My brother did not get back until ten, and Mum waited so long that she fell asleep.
items.why: Mum falling asleep waiting means ten was late: 才, with no 了. 就 plus 了 would make ten early, against the second clause.

items.q: 这个玩具太简单了，女儿玩一会儿___不玩了。
items.zh: 这个玩具太简单了，女儿玩一会儿就不玩了。
items.py: zhè ge wán jù tài jiǎn dān le nǚ ér wán yī huì r jiù bù wán le
items.en: This toy is too easy; my daughter stopped playing with it after a little while.
items.why: 太简单 means she tired of it quickly, so a short time already leads to the result: 就. 才 would mean she played for a long time first.

items.q: 只有周末，爸爸___有时间陪孩子。
items.zh: 只有周末，爸爸才有时间陪孩子。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu zhōu mò bà ba cái yǒu shí jiān péi hái zi
items.en: Only at weekends does Dad have time to spend with the children.
items.why: 只有周末 is the only time that works, so 才. 就 would belong with 只要 or 如果.

items.q: 商场正在打折，我们去晚了，下午三点___到，好东西都卖完了。
items.zh: 商场正在打折，我们去晚了，下午三点才到，好东西都卖完了。
items.py: shāng chǎng zhèng zài dǎ zhé wǒ men qù wǎn le xià wǔ sān diǎn cái dào hǎo dōng xi dōu mài wán le
items.en: The mall had a sale, but we were late; we only got there at three and the good things were sold out.
items.why: Going late and finding things sold out makes three o'clock late: 才, with no 了. 就 would make three sound early, against 卖完了.

items.q: 爸爸一喝酒，脸___红。
items.zh: 爸爸一喝酒，脸就红。
items.py: bà ba yī hē jiǔ liǎn jiù hóng
items.en: Dad goes red in the face whenever he drinks.
items.why: 一喝酒…就 states a habit, with no 了. 才 and 还 do not pair with 一.

items.s: 银行在就超市旁边。
items.s_py: yín háng zài jiù chāo shì páng biān
items.zh: 银行就在超市旁边。
items.py: yín háng jiù zài chāo shì páng biān
items.en: The bank is right next to the supermarket.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and must come before 在. Putting it between 在 and the place is not possible in Chinese.

items.q: 我一买东西，钱___花完了。
items.zh: 我一买东西，钱就花完了。
items.py: wǒ yī mǎi dōng xi qián jiù huā wán le
items.en: Whenever I go shopping the money is gone in no time.
items.why: 一…就 links two events that follow immediately, so the money is spent as soon as I shop. 才 means slow and cannot pair with 一.

items.zh: 只要价钱合适我就买。
items.py: zhǐ yào jià qián hé shì wǒ jiù mǎi
items.en: As long as the price is right, I'll buy it.
items.why: 只要 opens the condition and 就 sits right before the result verb. 就 cannot come before the subject 我.

items.q: 只要天气好，我们___去公园。
items.zh: 只要天气好，我们就去公园。
items.py: zhǐ yào tiān qì hǎo wǒ men jiù qù gōng yuán
items.en: As long as the weather is good, we'll go to the park.
items.why: 只要 says the condition is enough, and the result takes 就. 才 belongs with 只有 and would make the condition sound hard to meet.

items.q: 我打了五次电话，姐姐___接。
items.zh: 我打了五次电话，姐姐才接。
items.py: wǒ dǎ le wǔ cì diàn huà jiě jie cái jiē
items.en: I rang five times before my sister picked up.
items.why: Needing five calls means it took effort: 才. 就 would mean she picked up straight away, which contradicts five calls.

items.s: 只要价钱便宜，我买就。
items.s_py: zhǐ yào jià qián pián yi wǒ mǎi jiù
items.zh: 只要价钱便宜，我就买。
items.py: zhǐ yào jià qián pián yi wǒ jiù mǎi
items.en: As long as the price is cheap, I'll buy it.
items.why: 就 must come right before its verb 买, after the subject 我. Putting it after the verb is not possible.

items.src: 我们等了一个小时，他来了。
items.src_py: wǒ men děng le yī gè xiǎo shí tā lái le
items.task: Say that he only came after we had waited an hour (use 才).
items.zh: 我们等了一个小时他才来。
items.py: wǒ men děng le yī gè xiǎo shí tā cái lái
items.en: We waited an hour before he finally came.
items.why: After an hour of waiting, his arrival is late: 才 goes after the second subject 他 and before 来, with no 了.

items.zh: 要是天气不好，我们就在家看电影。
items.py: yào shi tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men jiù zài jiā kàn diàn yǐng
items.en: If the weather is bad, we'll watch a film at home.
items.why: 就 sits after the second-clause subject 我们 and before the coverb phrase 在家. Putting 就 before 我们 would turn it into "only we".

items.q: 爸爸五点就下班___，还给我们买了蛋糕。
items.zh: 爸爸五点就下班了，还给我们买了蛋糕。
items.py: bà ba wǔ diǎn jiù xià bān le hái gěi wǒ men mǎi le dàn gāo
items.en: Dad finished work at five and even bought us a cake.
items.why: Leaving work at five is a finished event, so 就 takes 了. 过 would say he has done it at some time before, and 着 would describe a continuing state.

items.q: 我___想买一件外套，不想买别的。
items.zh: 我就想买一件外套，不想买别的。
items.py: wǒ jiù xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn wài tào bù xiǎng mǎi bié de
items.en: I only want to buy a coat and nothing else.
items.why: 就 before 想买一件 means "only one", matching "nothing else". 还 and 也 mean "also want", the opposite.

items.zh: 我在这儿就有一个朋友。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè r jiù yǒu yī gè péng you
items.en: I only have one friend here.
items.why: 就 meaning "only" goes right before 有 and the small amount. After 一个朋友 or before 我 it would not limit the amount.

items.src_py: nǚ ér huí dào jiā xiān xiě zuò yè
items.task: Say it with 一…就: as soon as she gets home, she does her homework first.
items.zh: 女儿一回到家就先写作业。
items.py: nǚ ér yī huí dào jiā jiù xiān xiě zuò yè
items.en: As soon as my daughter gets home she does her homework first.
items.why: 一 goes before 回到家 and 就 before 先写作业, each in front of its own verb. 才 would break the idea of "immediately".

items.q: 你要找的人___是他，那个穿蓝衣服的。
items.zh: 你要找的人就是他，那个穿蓝衣服的。
items.py: nǐ yào zhǎo de rén jiù shì tā nà ge chuān lán yī fu de
items.en: The person you're looking for is that man in blue.
items.why: 就 before 是 means "it is precisely him", which identifies the person. 也 would say he too is a person you are looking for.

items.zh: 我们家就爸爸会修电脑。
items.py: wǒ men jiā jiù bà ba huì xiū diàn nǎo
items.en: In our family only Dad can fix computers.
items.why: 就 meaning "only" goes right before the person it limits, 爸爸. After 会 it would no longer single out Dad.

items.q: 我一收到工资，___把钱存起来。
items.zh: 我一收到工资，就把钱存起来。
items.py: wǒ yī shōu dào gōng zī jiù bǎ qián cún qǐ lái
items.en: As soon as I get paid, I put the money away to save it.
items.why: 一收到…就 means the second action follows at once. 才 would mean late, the opposite idea.

items.q: 哥哥十八岁就上大学___，比同学早两年。
items.zh: 哥哥十八岁就上大学了，比同学早两年。
items.py: gē ge shí bā suì jiù shàng dà xué le bǐ tóng xué zǎo liǎng nián
items.en: My brother started university at eighteen, two years earlier than his classmates.
items.why: Starting university early is a finished fact, so 就 takes 了. 着 cannot mark the start, and 的 would need 是 earlier in the sentence.

items.q: 商店九点开门，妈妈八点半___到了。
items.zh: 商店九点开门，妈妈八点半就到了。
items.py: shāng diàn jiǔ diǎn kāi mén mā ma bā diǎn bàn jiù dào le
items.en: The shop opens at nine, and Mum was already there by half past eight.
items.why: Half past eight is before the shop even opens, so the speaker feels it is early: 就, with 了 at the end. 才 would mean late and cannot sit with this 了.

items.q: 全家人都去了，___妈妈没去。
items.zh: 全家人都去了，就妈妈没去。
items.py: quán jiā rén dōu qù le jiù mā ma méi qù
items.en: Everyone in the family went; only Mum did not.
items.why: 就 before 妈妈 means "only Mum". 也 would say Mum also did not go, which contradicts everyone going.

items.q: 我们在这个小区才住___半年，邻居还不太熟。
items.zh: 我们在这个小区才住了半年，邻居还不太熟。
items.py: wǒ men zài zhè ge xiǎo qū cái zhù le bàn nián lín jū hái bù tài shú
items.en: We've only lived in this neighbourhood for half a year, so we don't know the neighbours well yet.
items.why: 才 plus a length of time means "only", and the verb takes 了 for the finished stretch. 着 means a continuing state and 过 means a past experience, so neither fits.

items.q: 弟弟早上十点才起床，哥哥七点就出去跑步___。
items.zh: 弟弟早上十点才起床，哥哥七点就出去跑步了。
items.py: dì di zǎo shang shí diǎn cái qǐ chuáng gē ge qī diǎn jiù chū qù pǎo bù le
items.en: My younger brother only got up at ten, but my older brother had already gone running at seven.
items.why: 才起床 has no 了 while 就出去跑步 needs one, which is exactly the contrast. 着 and 过 cannot say the run has already happened.

items.src_py: jiě jie liù diǎn chī fàn
items.task: Say that my sister had eaten as early as six (it was early).
items.zh: 姐姐六点就吃饭了。
items.py: jiě jie liù diǎn jiù chī fàn le
items.en: My sister had eaten by six already.
items.why: Early means 就 after the time and before the verb, and one finished event takes 了. 才 would mean late and cannot take 了.

items.q: 今年冬天特别冷，十月___下雪了。
items.zh: 今年冬天特别冷，十月就下雪了。
items.py: jīn nián dōng tiān tè bié lěng shí yuè jiù xià xuě le
items.en: This winter is especially cold; it had already snowed by October.
items.why: Snow in October is early, and the sentence ends with 了: 就. 才 would mean 'not until October' and cannot take this 了.

items.q: 下雨的时候，教室里___有三个人，别的同学都回家了。
items.zh: 下雨的时候，教室里就有三个人，别的同学都回家了。
items.py: xià yǔ de shí hou jiào shì lǐ jiù yǒu sān gè rén bié de tóng xué dōu huí jiā le
items.en: When it rained, only three people were in the classroom; the other students had gone home.
items.why: 就 before 有 and a small number means 'only', matching 别的同学都回家了. 也 means 'also' and 都 means 'all', both of which contradict the empty room.

items.q: 天一冷，我___咳嗽。
items.zh: 天一冷，我就咳嗽。
items.py: tiān yī lěng wǒ jiù ké sou
items.en: Whenever it turns cold, I cough.
items.why: 一冷…就咳嗽 is the 'whenever' pattern: the second action follows at once. 才 reverses it to lateness, and 也 and 再 do not pair with 一.

items.q: 我一天___睡五个小时，难怪总是感冒。
items.zh: 我一天就睡五个小时，难怪总是感冒。
items.py: wǒ yī tiān jiù shuì wǔ gè xiǎo shí nán guài zǒng shì gǎn mào
items.en: I only sleep five hours a day, no wonder I always catch colds.
items.why: 就 before a verb and a small amount means 'only', and 难怪总是感冒 confirms it is too little. 也 'also' and 再 'again' do not fit.

items.s: 这件衣服十块钱才，真便宜。
items.s_py: zhè jiàn yī fu shí kuài qián cái zhēn pián yi
items.zh: 这件衣服才十块钱，真便宜。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu cái shí kuài qián zhēn pián yi
items.en: This piece of clothing is only ten kuai, really cheap.
items.why: 才 meaning 'only' comes before the price, not after it.

items.q: 天气预报说下午下雨，可是中午___下起来了。
items.zh: 天气预报说下午下雨，可是中午就下起来了。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō xià wǔ xià yǔ kě shì zhōng wǔ jiù xià qǐ lái le
items.en: The forecast said rain in the afternoon, but it had already started raining at noon.
items.why: Noon is earlier than the forecast afternoon, and the clause ends in 了: 就. 才 would mean the rain came later than expected, and 才 does not combine with this 了.

items.q: 你找医生吗？我___是医生。
items.zh: 你找医生吗？我就是医生。
items.py: nǐ zhǎo yī shēng ma wǒ jiù shì yī shēng
items.en: Are you looking for the doctor? I am the doctor.
items.why: 就是 identifies the very person asked about: 'I'm the one'. 也是 would mean 'I am a doctor too', which does not answer the question.

items.zh: 他一晒太阳就头疼。
items.py: tā yī shài tài yáng jiù tóu téng
items.en: He gets a headache as soon as he is in the sun.
items.why: 一 and 就 each stand directly before their own verb. The subject 他 can come before 一 or before 就.

items.q: 医生说他的年纪不大，今年___四十五岁，只要多运动，身体就会好起来。
items.zh: 医生说他的年纪不大，今年才四十五岁，只要多运动，身体就会好起来。
items.py: yī shēng shuō tā de nián jì bù dà jīn nián cái sì shí wǔ suì zhǐ yào duō yùn dòng shēn tǐ jiù huì hǎo qǐ lái
items.en: The doctor said he isn't old, only forty-five this year, and with more exercise his health will improve.
items.why: 不大 sets up 'only': 才 before the age says forty-five is young. 都 needs 了 and means 'already', 也 means 'also', and neither fits 年纪不大.

items.s: 全班同学都做完了，就小李还在写。
items.s_py: quán bān tóng xué dōu zuò wán le jiù xiǎo lǐ hái zài xiě
items.zh: 全班同学都做完了，就小李还在写。
items.py: quán bān tóng xué dōu zuò wán le jiù xiǎo lǐ hái zài xiě
items.en: Everyone in the class has finished; only Xiao Li is still writing.
items.why: 就 before a person means 'only', so 就小李 is correct even though it stands before the subject of the clause.

items.q: 我的家人都很健康，___我妈妈有一点咳嗽。
items.zh: 我的家人都很健康，就我妈妈有一点咳嗽。
items.py: wǒ de jiā rén dōu hěn jiàn kāng jiù wǒ mā ma yǒu yī diǎn ké sou
items.en: My family are all healthy; only my mum has a bit of a cough.
items.why: 就 before a person singles that person out: 'only my mum'. 也 and 都 cannot stand before the subject, and 还 does not add the exclusion needed after 都很健康.

items.q: 这里___是我们学校的医务室，门上写着呢。
items.zh: 这里就是我们学校的医务室，门上写着呢。
items.py: zhè lǐ jiù shì wǒ men xué xiào de yī wù shì mén shàng xiě zhe ne
items.en: This is our school's clinic, it says so on the door.
items.why: 就是 identifies the place exactly: 'this very spot is the clinic'. 也是 would say 'also', but no other clinic has been mentioned.

items.s: 现在七点才，你再睡一下吧。
items.s_py: xiàn zài qī diǎn cái nǐ zài shuì yī xià ba
items.zh: 现在才七点，你再睡一下吧。
items.py: xiàn zài cái qī diǎn nǐ zài shuì yī xià ba
items.en: It's only seven o'clock; sleep a little longer.
items.why: 才 for 'only' stands before the time, never after it: 才七点.

items.q: 下大雪那天，爸爸五点就起床___，妈妈七点才起床___。
items.zh: 下大雪那天，爸爸五点就起床了，妈妈七点才起床。
items.py: xià dà xuě nà tiān bà ba wǔ diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le mā ma qī diǎn cái qǐ chuáng
items.en: On the day of the heavy snow, Dad got up as early as five, and Mom didn't get up until seven.
items.why: The 就 clause is a finished early event and takes 了; the 才 'not until' clause takes none. 了|了 is tempting because both events are past, and ∅|了 puts 了 on the wrong clause.

items.s: 你不吃药，我就不让你去学校。
items.s_py: nǐ bù chī yào wǒ jiù bù ràng nǐ qù xué xiào
items.zh: 你不吃药，我就不让你去学校。
items.py: nǐ bù chī yào wǒ jiù bù ràng nǐ qù xué xiào
items.en: If you don't take your medicine, I won't let you go to school.
items.why: 就 follows the subject 我 and stands before 不让. This is the right place for 'then'.

items.s: 你要找的医生是就我。
items.s_py: nǐ yào zhǎo de yī shēng shì jiù wǒ
items.zh: 你要找的医生就是我。
items.py: nǐ yào zhǎo de yī shēng jiù shì wǒ
items.en: The doctor you're looking for is me.
items.why: 就 goes before 是 in the emphatic 就是, never after it.

items.q: 刚才出了一身汗，我换了衣服，没过十分钟就感冒___。
items.zh: 刚才出了一身汗，我换了衣服，没过十分钟就感冒了。
items.py: gāng cái chū le yī shēn hàn wǒ huàn le yī fu méi guò shí fēn zhōng jiù gǎn mào le
items.en: I had just sweated a lot, changed my clothes, and caught a cold within ten minutes.
items.why: A single finished event with 就 needs 了. 没过十分钟 shows it happened quickly, which is the 就 reading; dropping 了 would leave the sentence unfinished.

items.s: 我有就十块钱，买不了药。
items.s_py: wǒ yǒu jiù shí kuài qián mǎi bù liǎo yào
items.zh: 我就有十块钱，买不了药。
items.py: wǒ jiù yǒu shí kuài qián mǎi bù liǎo yào
items.en: I only have ten kuai, so I can't buy the medicine.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and goes before the verb 有, not after it: 就有十块钱.

items.q: 你问药店在哪儿？你看，药店___在医院旁边。
items.zh: 你问药店在哪儿？你看，药店就在医院旁边。
