items.py: nǐ wèn yào diàn zài nǎ r nǐ kàn yào diàn jiù zài yī yuàn páng biān
items.en: You're asking where the pharmacy is? Look, it's right next to the hospital.
items.why: 就在 points to the place precisely: 'right next to'. 也 would mean the pharmacy is also there, but nothing else has been mentioned.

items.q: 我家___在公园对面，走路两分钟。
items.zh: 我家就在公园对面，走路两分钟。
items.py: wǒ jiā jiù zài gōng yuán duì miàn zǒu lù liǎng fēn zhōng
items.en: My home is right opposite the park, a two-minute walk.
items.why: 就在 means 'right at' and agrees with 两分钟. 也在 would mean 'also at', and 都在 would mean 'all at', neither fitting a single home.

items.q: ___你不舒服，___要去看医生。
items.zh: 只要你不舒服，就要去看医生。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ bù shū fu jiù yào qù kàn yī shēng
items.en: As long as you feel unwell, you should see a doctor.
items.why: 'As long as' is 只要, and the easy result is answered by 就. 只有…才 would mean 'only if', and mixing the pairs (只要…才, 只有…就) is the classic error.

items.s: 雨停了，才我们能出门。
items.s_py: yǔ tíng le cái wǒ men néng chū mén
items.zh: 雨停了，我们才能出门。
items.py: yǔ tíng le wǒ men cái néng chū mén
items.en: We can only go out once the rain has stopped.
items.why: 才 is an adverb: it follows the subject and comes before the modal 能. It never starts a clause the way English 'only then' does.

items.q: 你感冒还没好，医生说你得再休息三天才能上班___。
items.zh: 你感冒还没好，医生说你得再休息三天才能上班。
items.py: nǐ gǎn mào hái méi hǎo yī shēng shuō nǐ děi zài xiū xi sān tiān cái néng shàng bān
items.en: You haven't recovered from your cold yet; the doctor says you must rest three more days before you can go to work.
items.why: This is a future condition with 才, and 才 never takes 了. A final 了 would wrongly turn it into a finished event.

items.q: 如果明天不下雨，我们___去爬山。
items.zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。
items.py: rú guǒ míng tiān bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù pá shān
items.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go hiking.
items.why: 如果 pairs with 就 in the second clause, right after the subject. 才 would turn the condition into 'only if', and 再 or 也 do not answer 如果.

items.q: 他昨天吃了药，一个小时就退烧___。
items.zh: 他昨天吃了药，一个小时就退烧了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān chī le yào yī gè xiǎo shí jiù tuì shāo le
items.en: He took the medicine yesterday and his fever was down within an hour.
items.why: 就 with a single finished event in the past takes 了. 才 would be the pattern with no 了, but 一个小时 is quick, so 就…了 is the pairing.

items.q: ___坚持锻炼，身体___会越来越好。
items.zh: 只有坚持锻炼，身体才会越来越好。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu jiān chí duàn liàn shēn tǐ cái huì yuè lái yuè hǎo
items.en: Only by keeping up regular exercise will your health get better and better.
items.why: 'Only by' is 只有, answered by 才. 只要…就 would mean 'as long as', which loses the single necessary condition in the English cue.

items.q: 体检的结果很快，半个小时___出来了。
items.zh: 体检的结果很快，半个小时就出来了。
items.py: tǐ jiǎn de jié guǒ hěn kuài bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù chū lái le
items.en: The check-up results are quick: they came out in just half an hour.
items.why: 很快 and a short half hour make 就 the right word, with 了 at the end. 才 would suggest the results were slow.

items.q: 我一喝冷水___肚子疼。
items.zh: 我一喝冷水就肚子疼。
items.py: wǒ yī hē lěng shuǐ jiù dù zi téng
items.en: I get a stomach ache as soon as I drink cold water.
items.why: 一 + action + 就 + result means 'as soon as / whenever'. 才 is the opposite idea of lateness, and 也 and 再 cannot complete 一.

items.src_py: tā hē lěng shuǐ dù zi téng
items.task: Say he gets it whenever he drinks, using 一…就.
items.zh: 他一喝冷水就肚子疼。
items.py: tā yī hē lěng shuǐ jiù dù zi téng
items.en: He gets a stomach ache as soon as he drinks cold water.
items.why: 一 and 就 each go right before their own verb. 他 can also come before 就 instead of before 一.

items.q: 现在___九月，天气还很热，不用穿外套。
items.zh: 现在才九月，天气还很热，不用穿外套。
items.py: xiàn zài cái jiǔ yuè tiān qì hái hěn rè bù yòng chuān wài tào
items.en: It's only September, the weather is still hot, and you don't need a coat.
items.why: 才 before a month means 'only, still early', matching 还很热. 已经 would imply a late date and is normally followed by 了.

items.q: ___你多喝水、多休息，感冒___会好得更快。
items.zh: 只要你多喝水、多休息，感冒就会好得更快。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ duō hē shuǐ duō xiū xi gǎn mào jiù huì hǎo de gèng kuài
items.en: As long as you drink plenty of water and rest, your cold will get better faster.
items.why: 'As long as' is 只要 with 就. 只有|才 would turn the advice into a single necessary condition, and 只要…才 and 如果…才 mismatch the pair.

items.q: 你要先把汗擦干，换上干衣服，我们___能出门，不然会着凉。
items.zh: 你要先把汗擦干，换上干衣服，我们才能出门，不然会着凉。
items.py: nǐ yào xiān bǎ hàn cā gān huàn shàng gān yī fu wǒ men cái néng chū mén bù rán huì zháo liáng
items.en: You have to wipe off the sweat and change into dry clothes first; we can't go out until then, or you'll catch a chill.
items.why: 先…才能 means we cannot go out until the conditions are met, so 才 comes right before 能. 就 would say going out is easy, which clashes with 不然会着凉.

items.q: 医生一看我的嗓子，___说我是上火了，让我多喝水。
items.zh: 医生一看我的嗓子，就说我是上火了，让我多喝水。
items.py: yī shēng yī kàn wǒ de sǎng zi jiù shuō wǒ shì shàng huǒ le ràng wǒ duō hē shuǐ
items.en: As soon as the doctor looked at my throat, he said I was run down and told me to drink more water.
items.why: 一看…就说 shows the diagnosis came immediately after the look. 才 would say it took a long time, and 再 would make it a later step.

items.zh: 小王昨天发着烧加班到十点才回家。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān fā zhe shāo jiā bān dào shí diǎn cái huí jiā
items.en: Xiao Wang worked overtime with a fever yesterday and didn't get home until ten.
items.why: 十点 comes before 才, which comes right before 回家. 昨天 may precede or follow 小王.

items.s: 这种药要连着吃三天才有用，你不能吃一次就不吃了。
items.s_py: zhè zhǒng yào yào lián zhe chī sān tiān cái yǒu yòng nǐ bù néng chī yī cì jiù bù chī le
items.zh: 这种药要连着吃三天才有用，你不能吃一次就不吃了。
items.py: zhè zhǒng yào yào lián zhe chī sān tiān cái yǒu yòng nǐ bù néng chī yī cì jiù bù chī le
items.en: You have to take this medicine for three days in a row before it works; don't stop after one dose.
items.why: 三天才有用 shows the effect is slow (才, no 了). 吃一次就不吃了 shows too little effort followed by 了. Both are right.

items.q: 这个月我___去过一次医院，身体比去年好多了。
items.zh: 这个月我就去过一次医院，身体比去年好多了。
items.py: zhè gè yuè wǒ jiù qù guo yī cì yī yuàn shēn tǐ bǐ qù nián hǎo duō le
items.en: This month I've only been to the hospital once; my health is much better than last year.
items.why: 就 plus 去过一次 means 'only once', fitting 身体好多了. 又 and 再 mean 'again', which would suggest repeated visits and clash with the good news.

items.q: 孩子一发烧，妈妈___着急得睡不着觉。
items.zh: 孩子一发烧，妈妈就着急得睡不着觉。
items.py: hái zi yī fā shāo mā ma jiù zháo jí de shuì bù zháo jiào
items.en: As soon as the child runs a fever, Mum is so worried she can't sleep.
items.why: 一 in the first clause needs 就 in the second, with its own subject 妈妈 in between. 才, 又 and 也 do not complete the 一…就 pattern.

items.q: 只有把药吃完，病___能好，不能自己停药。
items.zh: 只有把药吃完，病才能好，不能自己停药。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu bǎ yào chī wán bìng cái néng hǎo bù néng zì jǐ tíng yào
items.en: Only if you finish the medicine will the illness get better; you mustn't stop taking it yourself.
items.why: 只有 sets a necessary condition, so 才 stands before 能. 就 would say finishing is enough, and the warning 不能自己停药 stresses that it is required.

items.q: 你要找的那位体检医生___在二楼，上楼往左走，第一个门。
items.zh: 你要找的那位体检医生就在二楼，上楼往左走，第一个门。
items.py: nǐ yào zhǎo de nà wèi tǐ jiǎn yī shēng jiù zài èr lóu shàng lóu wǎng zuǒ zǒu dì yī gè mén
items.en: The doctor you're looking for is right on the second floor: go upstairs, turn left, the first door.
items.why: 就在 pinpoints the location and the directions follow. 也在 would say the doctor is there as well, 又在 does not fit, and 都在 would mean all the doctors.

items.s: 只要多休息，身体才会好起来。
items.s_py: zhǐ yào duō xiū xi shēn tǐ cái huì hǎo qǐ lái
items.zh: 只要多休息，身体就会好起来。
items.py: zhǐ yào duō xiū xi shēn tǐ jiù huì hǎo qǐ lái
items.en: As long as you rest more, your health will recover.
items.why: 只要 pairs with 就, not 才. 才 is for 只有, 'only if'.

items.q: 医生说这个病很难治，他吃了半年药___好。
items.zh: 医生说这个病很难治，他吃了半年药才好。
items.py: yī shēng shuō zhè ge bìng hěn nán zhì tā chī le bàn nián yào cái hǎo
items.en: The doctor said this illness is hard to treat; he took medicine for half a year before he got better.
items.why: 难治 and 半年 describe a slow, hard road, so 才 'not until'. 就 would make half a year sound quick, which clashes with the first clause.

items.q: 我们小区的游泳池，夏天___这一个开着，所以人特别多。
items.zh: 我们小区的游泳池，夏天就这一个开着，所以人特别多。
items.py: wǒ men xiǎo qū de yóu yǒng chí xià tiān jiù zhè yī gè kāi zhe suǒ yǐ rén tè bié duō
items.en: Of the pools in our neighbourhood, only this one is open in summer, which is why it is so crowded.
items.why: 就 right before 这一个 limits the group to one pool, which explains 人特别多. 都 would say all of them are open, and 也 'also' cannot explain the crowd.

items.q: 虽然外面下着大雪，孩子们吃完早饭，不到九点___跑出去堆雪人了。
items.zh: 虽然外面下着大雪，孩子们吃完早饭，不到九点就跑出去堆雪人了。
items.py: suī rán wài miàn xià zhe dà xuě hái zi men chī wán zǎo fàn bù dào jiǔ diǎn jiù pǎo chū qù duī xuě rén le
items.en: Although it was snowing hard, the children ran out to build a snowman before nine, right after breakfast.
items.why: 不到九点 is early and the clause ends in 了: 就. 才 would mean 'not until nine', which contradicts 不到九点.

items.src_py: tā shí diǎn dào le yī yuàn
items.task: Say he didn't get there until ten, using 才.
items.zh: 他十点才到医院。
items.py: tā shí diǎn cái dào yī yuàn
items.en: He didn't get to the hospital until ten.
items.why: 才 stands right before the verb and drops the 了. 十点 stays in front of 才, and the time word may also go before 他.

items.q: 路上全是冰，只有等雪化了，车___能开。
items.zh: 路上全是冰，只有等雪化了，车才能开。
items.py: lù shang quán shì bīng zhǐ yǒu děng xuě huà le chē cái néng kāi
items.en: The road is all ice; the cars can only drive once the snow has melted.
items.why: 只有等…才能 is the 'only after' pattern, with 才 before 能. 就 would claim driving is easy, against 路上全是冰.

items.q: 她___五岁，不能一个人去医院。
items.zh: 她才五岁，不能一个人去医院。
items.py: tā cái wǔ suì bù néng yī gè rén qù yī yuàn
items.en: She is only five and can't go to the hospital alone.
items.why: 才 before an age means 'only, that is young', which explains why she can't go alone. 都 would need 了 (都五岁了) and says 'already'.

items.s: 只有天气好，我们就去海边玩。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu tiān qì hǎo wǒ men jiù qù hǎi biān wán
items.zh: 只有天气好，我们才去海边玩。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu tiān qì hǎo wǒ men cái qù hǎi biān wán
items.en: We only go to the beach when the weather is good.
items.why: 只有 names a necessary condition and takes 才. 就 pairs with 只要 or 如果.

items.q: 你不吃药，病___不会好。
items.zh: 你不吃药，病就不会好。
items.py: nǐ bù chī yào bìng jiù bù huì hǎo
items.en: If you don't take the medicine, you won't get better.
items.why: If-not-A-then-B takes 就, placed after the subject 病 and before 不会. 才 would mean 'not until', which does not fit a plain consequence.

items.q: 他的腿伤得很重，躺了整整三个月___能下床走路，大家都很担心。
items.zh: 他的腿伤得很重，躺了整整三个月才能下床走路，大家都很担心。
items.py: tā de tuǐ shāng de hěn zhòng tǎng le zhěng zhěng sān gè yuè cái néng xià chuáng zǒu lù dà jiā dōu hěn dān xīn
items.en: His leg was badly hurt: he couldn't get out of bed and walk until he had lain there for a full three months, and everyone was worried.
items.why: 整整三个月 is a long, slow recovery, so 才 comes before 能. 就 would say it was quick, which does not fit 伤得很重 and 大家都很担心.

items.s: 只有雨停了，我们才能出发。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu yǔ tíng le wǒ men cái néng chū fā
items.zh: 只有雨停了，我们才能出发。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu yǔ tíng le wǒ men cái néng chū fā
items.en: We can only set off once the rain has stopped.
items.why: 只有 is answered by 才, which stands after the subject and before 能. This is the standard pairing.

items.s: 这个孩子才六岁，就已经戴眼镜了。
items.s_py: zhè ge hái zi cái liù suì jiù yǐ jīng dài yǎn jìng le
items.zh: 这个孩子才六岁，就已经戴眼镜了。
items.py: zhè ge hái zi cái liù suì jiù yǐ jīng dài yǎn jìng le
items.en: This child is only six and already wears glasses.
items.why: Both words are right: 才六岁 means 'only six', and 就…了 says it happened early.

items.q: 今天天气不好，同学们都没来，___小王来了。
items.zh: 今天天气不好，同学们都没来，就小王来了。
items.py: jīn tiān tiān qì bù hǎo tóng xué men dōu méi lái jiù xiǎo wáng lái le
items.en: The weather is bad today and the classmates didn't come; only Xiao Wang came.
items.why: 就 before 小王 means 'only Xiao Wang', contrasting with 同学们都没来. 也 would say Xiao Wang came too, which contradicts the first clause.

items.q: 冬天的衣服我___有两件，不够穿。
items.zh: 冬天的衣服我就有两件，不够穿。
items.py: dōng tiān de yī fu wǒ jiù yǒu liǎng jiàn bù gòu chuān
items.en: I only have two winter garments, not enough to wear.
items.why: 就 before 有 and a small amount means 'only', explaining 不够穿. 都 would mean 'all' or 'already', and 又 and 再 mean 'again', which does not fit.

items.q: 只有天气好，我们___能去海边玩。
items.zh: 只有天气好，我们才能去海边玩。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu tiān qì hǎo wǒ men cái néng qù hǎi biān wán
items.en: We can go to the beach only if the weather is good.
items.why: 只有 names the one necessary condition and is answered by 才. 就 pairs with 只要 or 如果, so 只有…就 is the classic mismatch.

items.src_py: zhè jiàn máo yī èr shí kuài qián
items.task: Say it is only twenty kuai (cheap), using 才.
items.zh: 这件毛衣才二十块钱。
items.py: zhè jiàn máo yī cái èr shí kuài qián
items.en: This sweater is only twenty kuai.
items.why: 才 goes before the price to mean 'only that little'. Placed after the price it would mean 'not until'.

items.q: 全家人都感冒了，___爷爷没事。
items.zh: 全家人都感冒了，就爷爷没事。
items.py: quán jiā rén dōu gǎn mào le jiù yé ye méi shì
items.en: The whole family caught a cold; only Grandpa is fine.
items.why: 就 in front of 爷爷 means 'only Grandpa'. 也 and 还 cannot start the clause this way, and 再 refers to repetition.

items.q: 我感冒___两天，不用担心，很快就会好。
items.zh: 我感冒才两天，不用担心，很快就会好。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào cái liǎng tiān bù yòng dān xīn hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo
items.en: I've only had a cold for two days; don't worry, I'll be better soon.
items.why: 才 plus 两天 expresses 'only two days', which supports 不用担心. 已经 would say two days is long and would normally need 了.

items.q: 我马上___去医院，你别担心。
items.zh: 我马上就去医院，你别担心。
items.py: wǒ mǎ shàng jiù qù yī yuàn nǐ bié dān xīn
items.en: I'm going to the hospital right away; don't worry.
items.why: 马上就 means 'right away', and 别担心 shows the speaker is acting now. 再 would push it to later, and 也 or 还 add the wrong idea.

items.q: 这把雨伞___十五块钱，真便宜，我买了两把。
items.zh: 这把雨伞才十五块钱，真便宜，我买了两把。
items.py: zhè bǎ yǔ sǎn cái shí wǔ kuài qián zhēn pián yi wǒ mǎi le liǎng bǎ
items.en: This umbrella is only fifteen kuai, really cheap, so I bought two.
items.why: 才 before a price means 'only, that's cheap', matching 真便宜. 都 would suggest it is already too much, and 再 means 'again' and cannot go before a price.

items.q: 今天下雨，我出门很早，六点___出门了。
items.zh: 今天下雨，我出门很早，六点就出门了。
items.py: jīn tiān xià yǔ wǒ chū mén hěn zǎo liù diǎn jiù chū mén le
items.en: It rained today and I left home early, at six.
items.why: 出门很早 says six o'clock was early: 就, and it fits the final 了. 才 would mean late and cannot take 了.

items.q: 你现在___去医院检查一下，别等到明天。
items.zh: 你现在就去医院检查一下，别等到明天。
items.py: nǐ xiàn zài jiù qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá yī xià bié děng dào míng tiān
items.en: Go to the hospital for a check-up right now; don't wait until tomorrow.
items.why: 现在就 means 'right now', which fits 别等到明天. 再 would postpone the action, the opposite of the instruction.

items.src: 你多喝水，感冒会好得快。
items.src_py: nǐ duō hē shuǐ gǎn mào huì hǎo de kuài
items.task: Say it is the only way, using 只有…才.
items.zh: 只有你多喝水，感冒才会好得快。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ duō hē shuǐ gǎn mào cái huì hǎo de kuài
items.en: Your cold will only get better quickly if you drink plenty of water.
items.why: 只有 is answered by 才, which stands before 会 after the subject 感冒. The condition clause can also follow 感冒.

items.q: 他一回到家，___先洗手，再吃饭。
items.zh: 他一回到家，就先洗手，再吃饭。
items.py: tā yī huí dào jiā jiù xiān xǐ shǒu zài chī fàn
items.en: As soon as he gets home, he washes his hands first and then eats.
items.why: 一 + verb + 就 describes an immediate action, and 就 stands before 先. 才 would turn it into 'not until', and 也 and 又 do not answer 一.

items.s: 我才学了两个月游泳，还游得不好。
items.s_py: wǒ cái xué le liǎng gè yuè yóu yǒng hái yóu de bù hǎo
items.zh: 我才学了两个月游泳，还游得不好。
items.py: wǒ cái xué le liǎng gè yuè yóu yǒng hái yóu de bù hǎo
items.en: I've only been learning to swim for two months, and I'm not good yet.
items.why: 才 meaning 'only' before an amount can sit with 了 after the verb. The ban on 了 is only for 'not until' with a time point.

items.q: 他昨天跑步累坏了，今天睡到中午十二点___起床。
items.zh: 他昨天跑步累坏了，今天睡到中午十二点才起床。
items.py: tā zuó tiān pǎo bù lèi huài le jīn tiān shuì dào zhōng wǔ shí èr diǎn cái qǐ chuáng
items.en: He was worn out from running yesterday and didn't get up until noon today.
items.why: 睡到中午 is late for getting up, so 才, with no 了. 就 would need 了 and would present twelve o'clock as early.

items.q: 今年春天来得晚，四月___开花。
items.zh: 今年春天来得晚，四月才开花。
items.py: jīn nián chūn tiān lái de wǎn sì yuè cái kāi huā
items.en: Spring came late this year; the flowers didn't bloom until April.
items.why: 来得晚 says spring was late, so April is late too: 才. 就 would present April as early, which contradicts the first clause.

items.q: 雨一停，太阳___出来了，天气好多了。
items.zh: 雨一停，太阳就出来了，天气好多了。
items.py: yǔ yī tíng tài yáng jiù chū lái le tiān qì hǎo duō le
items.en: As soon as the rain stopped, the sun came out and the weather got much better.
items.why: 一停…就出来了: the sun appears right after the rain stops. 才 would say the sun was late, and 再 would make it a later step.

items.q: 我昨天晚上咳嗽，半夜两点才睡___。
items.zh: 我昨天晚上咳嗽，半夜两点才睡。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang ké sou bàn yè liǎng diǎn cái shuì
items.en: I coughed last night and didn't get to sleep until two in the morning.
items.why: 'Not until' 才 takes no 了, even though the event is finished. Adding 了 here is the classic error; 了 belongs with 就 (两点就睡了).

items.s: 药店在就医院旁边。
items.s_py: yào diàn zài jiù yī yuàn páng biān
items.zh: 药店就在医院旁边。
items.py: yào diàn jiù zài yī yuàn páng biān
items.en: The pharmacy is right next to the hospital.
items.why: 就 must come before 在, not between 在 and the place.

items.q: 那场台风很大，学校昨天上午九点就放假___。
items.zh: 那场台风很大，学校昨天上午九点就放假了。
items.py: nà chǎng tái fēng hěn dà xué xiào zuó tiān shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn jiù fàng jià le
items.en: That typhoon was big; the school closed as early as nine yesterday morning.
items.why: 就 plus one finished event in the past (昨天) needs 了. Without 了 the sentence sounds like a rule or a plan.

items.q: 他发烧了，睡了一觉___好了。
items.zh: 他发烧了，睡了一觉就好了。
items.py: tā fā shāo le shuì le yī jiào jiù hǎo le
items.en: He had a fever, but one sleep and he was better.
items.why: One sleep is little effort and the sentence ends in 了, so the speaker sounds pleasantly surprised: 就. 才 would suggest a long, hard recovery and does not take a final 了.

items.zh: 如果今天太冷你就别出去了。
items.py: rú guǒ jīn tiān tài lěng nǐ jiù bié chū qù le
items.en: If it's too cold today, then don't go out.
items.why: 就 sits after the second subject 你, right before 别出去了. Putting 就 before 你 would change its meaning to 'only you'.

items.zh: 今年十月就下雪了。
items.py: jīn nián shí yuè jiù xià xuě le
items.en: It was already snowing as early as October this year.
items.why: The time 十月 comes before 就, and 就 sits directly before the verb 下雪了.

items.q: 你看，你们要找的诊所___是前面那个红色的房子。
items.zh: 你看，你们要找的诊所就是前面那个红色的房子。
items.py: nǐ kàn nǐ men yào zhǎo de zhěn suǒ jiù shì qián miàn nà gè hóng sè de fáng zi
items.en: Look, the clinic you're looking for is that red building ahead.
items.why: 你看 signals pointing it out, so 就是 means 'precisely that one'. 也是 would say it is also the red building, which no context supports.

items.q: 天气太热，我们昨天晚上九点才吃饭___。
items.zh: 天气太热，我们昨天晚上九点才吃饭。
items.py: tiān qì tài rè wǒ men zuó tiān wǎn shang jiǔ diǎn cái chī fàn
items.en: It was too hot, so we didn't eat until nine last night.
items.why: 才 'not until' takes no 了 even for something that already happened. 了 would be the 就 pattern (九点就吃饭了), which the late 九点 does not fit.

items.q: 冬天的早上，现在___七点，天还没亮。
items.zh: 冬天的早上，现在才七点，天还没亮。
items.py: dōng tiān de zǎo shang xiàn zài cái qī diǎn tiān hái méi liàng
items.en: On a winter morning it's only seven o'clock and it's still dark.
items.why: 才 directly before a clock time means 'only that early'. 已经 would mean 'already' and needs 了 after the time.

items.q: 要是你每天早上都起来跑步，身体___会好很多，感冒也会少很多。
items.zh: 要是你每天早上都起来跑步，身体就会好很多，感冒也会少很多。
items.py: yào shi nǐ měi tiān zǎo shang dōu qǐ lái pǎo bù shēn tǐ jiù huì hǎo hěn duō gǎn mào yě huì shǎo hěn duō
items.en: If you got up to run every morning, your health would be much better and you'd catch fewer colds.
items.why: 要是 (if) is answered by 就 before 会. 才 would turn it into 'only if', which the sentence does not say, and 再 and 又 mean 'again'.

items.q: 我儿子一岁半___会走路，比别的孩子慢多了。
items.zh: 我儿子一岁半才会走路，比别的孩子慢多了。
items.py: wǒ ér zi yī suì bàn cái huì zǒu lù bǐ bié de hái zi màn duō le
items.en: My son didn't walk until he was a year and a half, much later than other children.
items.why: The age comes before 才: 'not until that age'. 慢多了 shows it was late, so 就 (early) is wrong.

items.q: 这个药很有效，我吃了两天___不咳嗽了。
items.zh: 这个药很有效，我吃了两天就不咳嗽了。
items.py: zhè ge yào hěn yǒu xiào wǒ chī le liǎng tiān jiù bù ké sou le
items.en: This medicine works well; after only two days I'd stopped coughing.
items.why: 很有效 and a short two days point to 就, and the final 了 supports it. 才 would mean it took a long time, against 很有效.

items.q: 这个孩子___六个月，已经会笑了。
items.zh: 这个孩子才六个月，已经会笑了。
items.py: zhè ge hái zi cái liù gè yuè yǐ jīng huì xiào le
items.en: This baby is only six months old and can already laugh.
items.why: 才 before an age means 'only'. 都 would need 了 (都六个月了) and would mean 'already six months', which does not fit the contrast with 已经会笑了.

items.q: 冬天天黑得早，下午五点天___黑了。
items.zh: 冬天天黑得早，下午五点天就黑了。
items.py: dōng tiān tiān hēi de zǎo xià wǔ wǔ diǎn tiān jiù hēi le
items.en: In winter it gets dark early; it is already dark at five in the afternoon.
items.why: 黑得早 means five o'clock is early for dark, and the sentence ends in 了: 就. 才 would flip the meaning to 'not until'.

items.zh: 只有按时吃药你的病才能好。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu àn shí chī yào nǐ de bìng cái néng hǎo
items.en: Your illness will only get better if you take your medicine on time.
items.why: 只有 is answered by 才, which stands right before 能好 after the subject. The condition clause can also follow 你的病.

items.s: 一下雪，路上就堵车。
items.s_py: yī xià xuě lù shang jiù dǔ chē
items.zh: 一下雪，路上就堵车。
items.py: yī xià xuě lù shang jiù dǔ chē
items.en: Whenever it snows, the roads get jammed.
items.why: 一下雪 can have no subject, and 路上 is the subject of the second clause, so 就 sits after it, before 堵车.

items.q: 你如果不舒服，我___陪你去医院。
items.zh: 你如果不舒服，我就陪你去医院。
items.py: nǐ rú guǒ bù shū fu wǒ jiù péi nǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: If you don't feel well, I'll go to the hospital with you.
items.why: 如果 pairs with 就, which sits after the subject 我 and before the verb 陪. 才 would make it 'only if', and 再 or 又 do not answer 如果.

items.q: 她病得很重，昨天一早就去医院___。
items.zh: 她病得很重，昨天一早就去医院了。
items.py: tā bìng de hěn zhòng zuó tiān yī zǎo jiù qù yī yuàn le
items.en: She was very ill and went to the hospital first thing yesterday.
items.why: One finished event with 就 needs 了 at the end. Without it the sentence sounds like a habit or plan, which clashes with 昨天.

items.src: 只有小王一个人没吃药。
items.src_py: zhǐ yǒu xiǎo wáng yī gè rén méi chī yào
items.task: Say it with 就 instead of 只有.
items.zh: 就小王一个人没吃药。
items.py: jiù xiǎo wáng yī gè rén méi chī yào
items.en: Only Xiao Wang didn't take his medicine.
items.why: 就 can replace 只有 as 'only' directly before the person. It cannot follow 小王一个人 and keep the meaning.

items.q: 夏天他一晒太阳___头晕。
items.zh: 夏天他一晒太阳就头晕。
items.py: xià tiān tā yī shài tài yáng jiù tóu yūn
items.en: In summer he gets dizzy as soon as he is out in the sun.
items.why: 一晒太阳…就头晕 is the 'whenever' pattern: 就 right before the second verb. 才 means 'not until', the opposite of immediate, and 也 and 又 do not fit 一.

items.zh: 医务室就在二楼最里面。
items.py: yī wù shì jiù zài èr lóu zuì lǐ miàn
items.en: The clinic is right at the far end of the second floor.
items.why: 就 goes before 在, never after it: 就在二楼.

items.q: 一到下雨天，奶奶的腿___疼。
items.zh: 一到下雨天，奶奶的腿就疼。
items.py: yī dào xià yǔ tiān nǎi nai de tuǐ jiù téng
items.en: Whenever it's a rainy day, Grandma's leg hurts.
items.why: 一到下雨天 sets up the trigger and 就 sits right before 疼 in the second clause. 才 is the wrong direction, and 也 and 再 do not pair with 一.

items.s: 一我吃这种药，就想睡觉。
items.s_py: yī wǒ chī zhè zhǒng yào jiù xiǎng shuì jiào
items.zh: 我一吃这种药就想睡觉。
items.py: wǒ yī chī zhè zhǒng yào jiù xiǎng shuì jiào
items.en: As soon as I take this medicine, I feel sleepy.
items.why: 一 goes right before the verb, after the subject: 我一吃. It cannot stand in front of 我.

items.zh: 我女儿才两岁不会说很多话。
items.py: wǒ nǚ ér cái liǎng suì bù huì shuō hěn duō huà
items.en: My daughter is only two and can't say many words yet.
items.why: 才 comes before the age to mean 'only'. After the number it would mean 'not until'.

items.q: 只要有太阳，衣服___干得快。
items.zh: 只要有太阳，衣服就干得快。
items.py: zhǐ yào yǒu tài yáng yī fu jiù gān de kuài
items.en: As long as there's sun, clothes dry quickly.
items.why: 只要 says the condition is enough, so the easy result takes 就. 才 would need 只有 earlier, and 再 and 也 do not answer 只要.

items.q: 夏天天黑得晚，晚上八点天___黑。
items.zh: 夏天天黑得晚，晚上八点天才黑。
items.py: xià tiān tiān hēi de wǎn wǎn shang bā diǎn tiān cái hēi
items.en: In summer it gets dark late; it doesn't get dark until eight in the evening.
items.why: 黑得晚 tells us eight o'clock is late for dark: 才. 就 would imply dark comes early and would need 了.

items.zh: 你别着急我马上就到医院。
items.py: nǐ bié zháo jí wǒ mǎ shàng jiù dào yī yuàn
items.en: Don't worry, I'll be at the hospital right away.
items.why: 马上就 means 'right away', with 就 directly before 到医院. 马上 can stand before or after 我, and the two clauses can swap.

items.zh: 他昨天晚上咳嗽到三点才睡。
items.py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shang ké sou dào sān diǎn cái shuì
items.en: He coughed until three last night before he finally got to sleep.
items.why: 三点 comes before 才, which sits right before 睡. The time word 昨天晚上 may stand before or after 他.

items.s: 我家就在医院后面，走路五分钟就到了。
items.s_py: wǒ jiā jiù zài yī yuàn hòu miàn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le
items.zh: 我家就在医院后面，走路五分钟就到了。
items.py: wǒ jiā jiù zài yī yuàn hòu miàn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le
items.en: My home is right behind the hospital; it's just a five-minute walk.
items.why: The first 就 is 'precisely' before 在, and the second is 'only / early' with 了. Both are correctly placed.

items.s: 冬天的早上，我六点半就起床了，可是天还没亮。
items.s_py: dōng tiān de zǎo shang wǒ liù diǎn bàn jiù qǐ chuáng le kě shì tiān hái méi liàng
items.zh: 冬天的早上，我六点半就起床了，可是天还没亮。
items.py: dōng tiān de zǎo shang wǒ liù diǎn bàn jiù qǐ chuáng le kě shì tiān hái méi liàng
items.en: On a winter morning I got up at half past six, but it was still dark.
items.why: 就 with a finished event takes 了, and 六点半 feels early to the speaker. The sentence is fully correct.

items.s: 我每天晚上十二点才睡了。
items.s_py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái shuì le
items.zh: 我每天晚上十二点才睡。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái shuì
items.en: I don't go to bed until twelve every night.
items.why: 才 meaning 'not until' never takes 了, and a daily habit makes a final 了 plainly wrong because 了 marks one completed event.

items.zh: 就小王一个人没来体检。
items.py: jiù xiǎo wáng yī gè rén méi lái tǐ jiǎn
items.en: Only Xiao Wang didn't come for the check-up.
items.why: 就 stands right before the person it limits. After 小王一个人 it would no longer mean 'only'. The topic 体检 may also be fronted.
